title: 3D Product Designer for 3D Printing
description:
Nut Dreamers and its affiliate companies are looking for a talented 3D Product Designer to help create product concepts, prototypes, and production-ready designs for 3D printing. This role is ideal for someone who understands both design and functionality, and can turn ideas into accurate, printable 3D models.



Responsibilities



* Create 3D product designs based on our ideas, sketches, references, or brand guidelines.

* Design products that are functional, clean, and ready for 3D printing.

* Prepare files for prototyping and manufacturing.

* Make revisions based on feedback and testing.

* Create realistic 3D renders for review, presentations, and product development.

* Help improve product shape, usability, dimensions, and overall appearance.

* Organize and deliver final source files properly.



Required Skills



* Strong experience with 3D product design.

* Experience designing for 3D printing and prototyping.

* Proficiency in software such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Blender, Rhino, or similar.

* Strong understanding of measurements, tolerances, materials, and print limitations.

* Ability to create clean, accurate, and editable 3D files.

* Good communication and attention to detail.



Deliverables



Final files should include:



* STL

* STEP

* OBJ

* 3MF, when applicable

* High-resolution renders

* Editable source files



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of product design from concept to printable file. The ideal candidate is creative, technical, detail-oriented, and able to design products that look premium while still being practical to produce.



30-Day Probation Period



This position includes a 30-day probation period to evaluate design quality, communication, turnaround time, and overall fit. Successful completion may lead to a long-term working relationship with Nut Dreamers and its affiliate companies.



Please submit your resume and portfolio in PDF format.

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Finance & Cashflow Manager
description:
Finance & Cash Flow Manager — Remote, Part-Time

E-Commerce · Subscription Business · DTC Brand



We run a growing direct-to-consumer brand with a subscription model. We spend six figures a month on paid advertising across Meta and operate multiple stores. We need someone detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable with numbers to own our day-to-day financial tracking.



This is a numbers-first role. You tell us exactly where we stand — not just at month end, but daily.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Daily Finance Tracking

Log daily ad spend per store (Meta), record daily orders and revenue, track front-end sales vs subscription rebill revenue separately, calculate daily CPA, and flag any day where CPA exceeds agreed thresholds.



Subscription Rebill Tracking

Track biweekly subscription billing cycles per customer cohort, log which bill number each cohort is on, record actual subscription revenue vs projected, and track approval rates on each billing attempt.



Cost of Goods & Order Management

Track COG per order across stores, ensure COG invoices are paid on schedule, and flag any discrepancy between orders and COG invoiced.



Customer Service Coordination (light)

Work with our CS team to stay on top of refund volumes and compile a simple weekly summary of refunds and chargebacks. Basic awareness of processing fees helpful.



Cash Flow & Bank Balance

Maintain a live business bank account balance tracker updated daily. Track payout timing from our payment processor and flag immediately if the balance is getting tight.



Reporting

Weekly P&L summary every Monday. Monthly profit report broken down by store. Maintain the master Google Sheet tracker.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:



Strong Google Sheets skills — formulas, formatting, comfortable building trackers from scratch

Experience tracking finances for an e-commerce or similar business

Understanding of subscription billing and recurring revenue

Works independently with minimal supervision

Available daily to log and update numbers

Responds within a few hours during business hours

Fluent English — clear written communication



Nice to have:



Experience with Shopify or similar platforms

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager

Previous work with subscription, dropshipping, or e-commerce businesses



KEY METRICS YOU WILL OWN



Daily CPA · Bank balance · Refund rate · Chargeback rate · COG payments



Numbers must be updated daily. Accuracy is everything.



WHAT THIS IS NOT



Not a bookkeeping or accounting role. Not a one-hour-a-week job — this requires daily attention. Not a passive role — we need someone who flags issues before they become problems.



PAY



We are very open on pay. Quality is what matters to us — if you are genuinely good at this, the compensation will reflect it.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short message covering:

title: Bookkeeper + Executive Assistant
description:
JOB TYPE / HOURS:

Full-time, long-term. 8:30 am to 5:30 pm overlap with US Pacific time required; rest flexible.



SALARY:

$700–$1,000/month depending on experience, plus raises and bonuses as you grow with us.



ABOUT US:

We're a commercial refrigeration door and gasket service company for the food & beverage market run by a small, friendly team. I'm looking for one reliable, detail-loving person to become my right hand — someone I can train once and then trust. I treat my team well: I want you here for years, I pay on time, and I care about your growth.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online (categorizing, reconciliations, keeping books clean)

• Simple cash-flow tracking and basic P&L reporting each week/month

• QBO inventory: updating prices and adding new SKUs accurately

• Updating and maintaining data in our AI built CRM and in spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel)

• General executive-assistant help for me: inbox/calendar, follow-ups, research, small projects



WHO YOU ARE:

• Experienced with QuickBooks Online and comfortable with numbers and accuracy

• Great written English and clear, proactive communication

• Tech-savvy and a fast learner — you like figuring things out and don't need to be told twice

• Organized, honest, and dependable. You flag problems early instead of hiding them.



HOW TO APPLY (please read carefully):

1. Use this exact subject line: "I want to be your right hand — #1"

2. In your first sentence, tell me the number of years you've used QuickBooks Online.

3. Then, briefly: describe one bookkeeping mess you cleaned up and how you fixed it.

4. Tell me one tool or software you taught yourself, and how you learned it.



Applications that don't follow steps 1 and 2 exactly will not be considered.

title: Cold Caller
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a confident, personable cold caller to reach out to restaurant managers, grocery store owners, and convenience store operators from a lead database we provide. Your job is to get the decision-maker on the phone, briefly explain what we do, and book a free first visit where we inspect their equipment and replace the first gasket at no charge.



What You'll Do

• Call a provided list of restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores in the Sacramento / Reno / Lake Tahoe area.

• Navigate to the owner, general manager, or kitchen manager.

• Deliver a short, natural pitch about our free first inspection and gasket replacement offer.

• Overcome common objections (e.g., "we already have a guy," "we do it ourselves," "not interested right now").

• Book the appointment and log the outcome in our CRM.

• Track your daily call volume and conversion metrics.







What We're Looking For

• Proven cold calling or telemarketing experience — you're comfortable with rejection and know how to turn a "no" into a conversation.

• Excellent spoken English — clear, natural, and confident on the phone with American business owners and managers.

• Resilience & persistence — you don't get discouraged after a few hang-ups.

• Quick thinking — you can handle objections without sounding scripted.

• Reliable setup — a stable internet connection and a quiet workspace for making calls (we'll provide the dialer/softphone).

• US business experience — calling US-based businesses is a strong plus.

• Industry familiarity — experience with the food service or restaurant industry is a bonus but not required.



To help us get to know you better, please fill out this brief Google Form in addition to submitting your resume and application.

Key Responsibilities

title: Lead Video Editor + QC Manager for Top US Supplement Brand (Meta Ads, Build Your Own Team)
description:
We are a US supplement and e-commerce company doing 9 figures in annual revenue. We are building an in-house video editing team of 10-15 editors producing direct response video ads for
, Instagram, and TikTok, and we are hiring the LEAD EDITOR who will run it.

This is not a normal editing job. You will be our first hire and the leader of the team. You will edit, but your bigger job is quality control and building the pod.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:



Edit high-performing video ads (UGC style, VSLs, hook variations) using scripts, briefs, and raw footage we provide

Review and approve every video the team produces before it ships. Nothing goes live unless you say it is a 10/10

Help us build the SOPs, templates, and editing standards for the team

Help us recruit, test, and train 10-15 editors over the next 90 days (we pay referral bonuses if you bring people you trust)

Manage daily throughput so the team hits its output targets



WHAT WE PROVIDE:



Scripts, briefs, and raw footage delivered through an organized system (Airtable + 
). You will never work from a blank page

AI tools and subscriptions (ElevenLabs, AI video tools, stock libraries) all paid by us

Direct communication through Slack, not through this platform

Stable long-term full-time role, 13th month pay, paid PH holidays, and pay raises tied to team performance



REQUIREMENTS:



3+ years editing video ADS 
/TikTok direct response ads, not weddings, not vlogs, not corporate videos)

Expert in Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro, After Effects is a plus

You have worked for a US/international e-commerce brand or ad agency before

You have QC'd or managed other editors before, OR you are a senior editor ready to step up

Strong written English and reliable internet

Full time, no other clients



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly or you will not be considered):



Start your application with the word PINEAPPLE so we know you read this

Send a link to your portfolio showing AD work specifically. Label which ads you edited yourself

Record a 2-3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and telling us about the best performing ad you ever edited and why it worked

Tell us your expected monthly salary



Shortlisted applicants will be given a PAID test project ($75, 48-hour deadline): raw footage + a script + a reference ad, and you produce one finished ad. This is exactly how the real job works.

We are hiring immediately. The right person starts within 2 weeks.

title: AI Image Prompt Specialist
description:
AI Image Prompt Specialist



Overview

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience generating high-quality, realistic AI images

using text-to-image tools. This is a prompting-focused role, not an engineering role. You'll be

creating images, videos, and characters daily for our platform, so we need someone who

already knows what works and what doesn't when it comes to getting great outputs from

generative AI.



What You'll Do

- Write and iterate on prompts to generate realistic, high-quality images across styles and use cases

- Generate AI videos and character assets for our platform

- Work with tools like Nano Banana Pro, z-image, and similar image generation platforms

- Develop and maintain a library of proven prompts, styles, and workflows

- Collaborate with the team on creative direction and visual output standards

- Stay current with new models, tools, and prompting techniques as the space evolves



What We're Looking For

- Demonstrated experience prompting AI image generators (share your portfolio or examples)

- Strong understanding of what makes AI-generated images look realistic vs. artificial

- Familiarity with prompt structure, negative prompts, style references, seed management, and parameter tuning

- An eye for detail, especially around common AI artifacts (hands, faces, lighting, anatomy)

- Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal oversight

- Experience with advanced workflows like ComfyUI, A1111, or similar node-based/local setups



Nice to Have

- Background in AI video generation tools

title: Graphic Designer (Canva) – Wedding Designs & Client Approvals (Excellent English Required)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Part Time WAGE / SALARY: $5.50 per hour HOURS PER WEEK: 15





JOB OVERVIEW

We're a growing events business based in Ireland and the UK, and we're looking for a Canva designer who's just as comfortable talking to clients as they are laying out a design.



Every couple who books with us gets a custom design created for their wedding. It's the part of our service people get most excited about, so getting it right matters.



You'd own that whole piece: building the design, sending it to the couple, gathering their feedback, making the tweaks, and getting a clear sign-off before the event. Most of it runs off our existing Canva master template, so this isn't a blank-canvas design job. It's careful, accurate template work plus the confidence to handle a logo, a layout tweak or a slightly unusual request without needing to ask about every small thing.



Weddings are the bulk of the work. There's occasional corporate and other events too.



**What you'll do**

- Build each client's design in Canva from our master template (names, chosen design style, fonts, venue illustration, any supplied logo or photo)

- Proof your own work carefully. Names spelled right, dates right, everything aligned

- Export and
 the design to the client for approval, in our tone of voice

- Handle revision rounds. Font changes, spelling fixes, a different design option, logo sizing, colour tweaks

- Chase clients who've gone quiet so designs don't drift toward the event date

- Get a clear written sign-off from every client before the event

- Export approved designs in the formats our on-the-day team needs

- Keep our Google Sheet and HubSpot updated at each stage so everyone can see where a booking stands

- Flag anything unusual or fully custom to us before starting on it





**What we're looking for**

- Excellent written English. You'll be
ing brides and grooms directly, so this is the #1 requirement

- Strong Canva skills and a genuinely good eye for spacing, alignment and type

- Extremely detail-focused. A misspelled surname on a wedding design is the one mistake we can't have

- Comfortable owning a client conversation from first draft to sign-off, politely and warmly

- Organised enough to juggle 10-20 live designs at different stages without losing track of any of them

- Reliable, proactive, and happy to follow a clear process





**Comfortable using**

- Canva (template edits, layout adjustments, importing logos and images)

- Gmail (client correspondence, labelling, organising)

- HubSpot (updating deal stages and contact records)

- Google Sheets (our bookings tracker is the system of record)

- AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini)





**Nice to have**

- Experience designing for weddings, events or hospitality

- Prior client-facing design or account management work with international clients

- Basic illustration ability (we build venue illustrations and occasionally need new ones)

- Bonus points if you can structure some of your hours to overlap with UK/Ireland time





**How the work is paced**

- Designs go out within 48 hours of a client sending us their details, and they're finished 1-2 months ahead of the wedding. That means the workload is steady rather than frantic, but nothing can be left to sit. We'd rather you flag a delay early than let a design creep toward the event date.



**HOURS**

10-15 hours per week to start, with the opportunity for more as we grow. This is a long-term role with consistent hours.



**PERFORMANCE INCENTIVE**

To reward consistency and commitment, we offer a bonus of $250 paid after successfully completing 90 days in the role. This is paid in full once the trial period is completed.



To apply

Send us:

A short note in your own words about a design project where you dealt directly with the client

Two or three examples of Canva work you've done (wedding or event work especially welcome)



Please put the word PRINT at the top of your application so we know you've read the full post.

title: AI Backend Engineer / AI Integration Engineer (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote | Full-time



We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer who is comfortable working with Linux, servers, APIs, and open-source software, and who is highly interested in the fast-moving generative AI ecosystem.



You do not need to be a machine learning researcher, and you do not need years of previous AI experience.



What matters more is that you are a strong engineer who can quickly understand unfamiliar open-source projects, get them running, troubleshoot problems independently, and turn new technologies into usable product features.



What We’re Looking For?

3+ years of professional development experience with at least one backend programming language, such as Python, PHP, Java, Node.js, Ruby, Go, or similar.

Strong backend development experience, preferably with Python.

Very comfortable working with Linux and command-line environments.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Familiar with Git, Docker, Python environments, APIs, server deployment, and dependency management.

Able to independently deploy and maintain services on Linux servers.

Comfortable reading GitHub repositories, technical documentation, issues, discussions, and source code.

Able to quickly understand unfamiliar open-source projects and make them work.

Strong ability to troubleshoot environment, dependency, GPU, CUDA, memory, and deployment issues.

Highly proactive and self-driven.

Strong interest in generative AI and open-source technologies.

Willing to continuously experiment with new tools, models, and workflows.

Comfortable working remotely with strong self-management and online communication skills.



We value practical engineering ability, curiosity, and learning speed more than formal AI or machine learning credentials.



What You’ll Do?

Build, modify, debug, and optimize ComfyUI workflows.

Research newly released open-source image, video, audio, and multimodal generation models.

Quickly test promising models and understand their actual capabilities, limitations, hardware requirements, and potential product use cases.

Deploy open-source models on GPU servers.

Integrate useful models and workflows into our apps, websites, and backend services.

Build APIs and backend services around AI generation pipelines.

Research different LoRA training tools and training workflows.

Run LoRA training experiments and tune training configurations to improve results.

Compare different models, checkpoints, LoRAs, workflows, and inference configurations.

Optimize generation speed, GPU memory usage, stability, and output quality.

Continuously follow GitHub, Hugging Face, 
, Reddit, X, YouTube, and other AI communities to discover useful new models and tools as early as possible.

Nice to Have



Previous experience in the following areas is helpful, but not required:



ComfyUI

Hugging Face models

Image or video generation models

LoRA training

PyTorch

CUDA and GPU environments

RunPod, Vast.ai, AWS, or other GPU cloud platforms

Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Qwen Image, Wan, or similar open-source models

musubi-tuner, AI Toolkit, kohya_ss, or similar training tools

The Kind of Person We Want



The generative AI ecosystem changes extremely quickly.



We are looking for someone who enjoys exploring new technologies and can learn through documentation, source code, community discussions, and experimentation.



When a useful open-source model is released, you should be able to quickly:



Find it.

Deploy it.

Test it.

Understand what it can and cannot do.

Modify or optimize the workflow.

Determine whether it is useful for our products.

Integrate it into production if it provides value.



You do not need to invent new AI models from scratch.



Your job is to stay close to the open-source AI ecosystem and turn the best available technologies into real product capabilities as quickly as possible.



Comfortable working remotely with strong self-management and online communication skills.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (Remote, Philippines)



San Miguel Painting is a family owned residential painting company in the Dallas-Fort Worth area of Texas, and we are on a mission to become the best painting brand in Texas. We are not just filling a seat. We are looking for someone who wants a career, a team to grow with, and a place to become truly great at what they do.



WORK SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time, USA. Please note this is a US daytime schedule, which falls during the evening and overnight hours in the Philippines. Only apply if you can commit to these hours long term.



COMPENSATION

$620 per month base (approximately $3.58 per hour, full time), plus performance rewards. You earn 50 cents for every appointment you set, and 10 dollars for every project won and paid, meaning the client signs and pays their deposit from an appointment you booked. The harder you work and the better you get, the more you earn. Top performers earn well above the base.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a phone specialist role and the engine of our growth. You are the first voice a future client hears, and you turn interest into booked proposals while making every caller feel taken care of from the very first hello. You keep our calendar full, you move fast on new leads, and you follow up until the job is booked. Our motto is Crafting Excellence Beyond the Brush, and that excellence starts on your call.



If you want to clock in, do the bare minimum, and clock out, this is not the place for you. If you want to be part of an elite team that pushes each other, celebrates wins together, and grows every single week, keep reading. We build like a family, and we win like one.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Speed to Lead: Respond to and call new leads fast. The quicker we reach them, the more we book.

- Inbound Call Management: Answer incoming calls with warmth and confidence, qualify the caller, and book them for a proposal.

- Outbound Calls and Lead Generation: Reach out and follow up with new leads to book and rebook appointments and keep new business coming in.

- Keep the Calendar Booked: Fill our sales calendar, confirm every appointment, and reduce no shows with reminders.

- High Quality Conversations: Serve the client first. Real conversations book more jobs than rushed ones.

- Post Proposal Follow Up: After a proposal is sent, follow up with clients to help book and close, especially when our sales rep cannot get to everyone.

- Pipeline Hygiene: Keep every lead accurate and up to date in PaintScout so nothing falls through the cracks.

- Go Above and Beyond: Own your lane fully. Spot ways to book more and improve the caller experience, and bring those ideas to the table.



PERFORMANCE TARGETS (YOUR SCORECARD)

These break into two groups. The Daily Non-Negotiables are fully in your hands, and we expect them every day. The Goals We Chase Together are the outcomes we drive toward as a team, coach you on, and celebrate when you hit them.



Daily Non-Negotiables, fully in your control:

- 75 to 100 plus calls per day.

- Speed to lead: first call attempt within 3 minutes or less of a new lead during business hours.

- Follow up at least 12 times across call, text, and
 before setting a lead aside, and even more persistently on paid leads. We paid to earn that conversation, so we do not give up on it. Most appointments come after the fourth touch.

- Log and update every lead in PaintScout the same day.



Goals We Chase Together, we coach and aim for these:

- Book 10 to 12 qualified appointments every week. This is our north star.

- Show rate: aim for 80 percent or more of your booked appointments to show up and have their proposal run. A booking truly counts when the client shows.

- Aim for at least 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes of talk time per day, growing as you sharpen your craft. Some days run slower than others, and that is okay. Effort and quality come first.



THE MINDSET WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Coachable: Eager to learn our scripts and get better every week.

- Open Mindset: You welcome feedback and new ideas.

- Brings Energy: You show up ready, positive, and hard to rattle.

- Client First: You genuinely want to serve people, not just hit a number.



QUALIFICATIONS

- Spoken English: Clear, warm, and confident spoken English is required. This is a phone role with US clients, so strong phone communication is the single most important qualification.

- Experience: Prior appointment setting, lead generation, sales support, customer service, or call center experience preferred, ideally for a US based business.

- Drive: You are motivated by hitting goals and earning more when you perform.

- Reliability: Highly dependable and consistent, with a strong commitment to showing up and following through.

- Tech Comfort: Comfortable learning CRM and scheduling software. Experience with PaintScout or similar is a plus.

- Home Office: A quiet, uninterrupted workspace, a reliable computer, a good headset, and a stable internet connection suitable for daily calls.



WHY JOIN SAN MIGUEL PAINTING

- We Are a Family: We live by our core values every single day: Collaboration, Responsibility, Service, Quality, and Integrity. When you win, we all win.

- Build a Career, Not Just a Job: We invest in our people. As we grow, you grow. Strong performers move up and take on more.

- Be Part of an Elite Team: We hold a high standard and we push each other to improve, scale, and grow together. You will be surrounded by people who want to be great.

- Your Voice Matters: We want your ideas. The best people here step up, speak up, and help us get better every day.

- A Long Term Home: We are looking for someone to build with us for years, not weeks.



TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word BRUSH so we know you read this posting all the way through.

2. Send your resume and a short note on why you want to grow with a team like ours.

3. Attach a 60 second voice recording where you introduce yourself and pretend you are calling a homeowner to book a painting proposal. We want to hear your phone voice.



We look forward to welcoming a new member to our family.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – AI-Powered Content (CapCut + Google Flow) | Health & Wellness Brand
description:
About Us



Miss Yerba is a fast-growing women's health & wellness supplement brand selling across Europe and the US. We produce high volumes of short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts. Our production system is AI-assisted — meaning we don't need a traditional video editor. We need someone who can follow a clear, repeatable workflow using modern AI tools to produce polished short-form videos at scale.



The Role



You'll be responsible for producing our daily short-form video content using a structured, step-by-step workflow that we've already built out. This is not creative guesswork — we have Loom walkthroughs, prompt documents, templates, and organized Google Drive folders ready for you.



Your daily workflow looks like this:



Receive a short prompt + assets (avatar image, base video)

Paste these into Google Flow to generate the video

Screenshot the old video's on-screen text

Send the screenshot to ChatGPT or Claude to get a rewritten version

Place the new on-screen text into our custom CapCut template

Export the final video and upload it to the correct Google Drive folder



That's it. Clean, repeatable, structured.



What We're Looking For



Experience with CapCut (comfortable using templates, adding text overlays, basic editing)

Comfortable working with AI tools (Google Flow, ChatGPT, Claude — or willing to learn fast)

Highly organized and structured — you follow SOPs, not your gut

Reliable and consistent — we need someone who delivers every day, not "when inspired"

Available 5–7 days per week (flexible on hours, but output must be daily)

Strong attention to detail — correct folders, correct text, correct formatting

Good English communication (you'll receive instructions and docs in English)



Tools You'll Use



Google Flow (AI video generation)

CapCut (editing + templates)

Google Drive (file organization)

ChatGPT / Claude (text rewriting)

Loom (for training walkthroughs)



Hours & Availability



Flexible schedule. What matters is consistent daily output. We'll agree on a weekly video target. Time zone: CET (Netherlands), but you can work on your own schedule as long as deadlines are met.



Salary



To be discussed based on experience and availability.



How to Apply



IMPORTANT: In the subject line of your application, include the word "matevideo". Applications without this word will be automatically rejected.



In your application, please include:



A short introduction about yourself

Your experience with CapCut (and any AI tools if applicable)

Your availability (days per week + hours per day)

A link to any short-form video work you've done (even personal projects count)



We have a complete onboarding system with Looms, SOPs, and prompt docs ready — so if you're a fast learner who thrives with structure, this role is built for you.

title: Remote Business Growth Consultant
description:
SO Good is a fast-growing Texas-based marketing company helping local businesses dominate Google Maps, Google Search, and AI search.



We are hiring a remote Business Growth Consultant who knows how to prospect, follow up, handle rejection, and close.



This is not a customer service role.



This is a hunting role.



You prospect.

You follow up.

You run demos.

You close.

You repeat.



Compensation



This position is 100% commission-only with uncapped earning potential.



There is no fixed salary.



Onboarding Commission

Earn 50% of the onboarding fee

Current onboarding fee is $1,000 per business unit

Current commission is $500 per business unit

Paid after onboarding is completed

Recurring Commission

Earn 5% of recurring client revenue

Paid while the customer remains active

Recurring commissions continue only while actively working with SO Good

Bonuses

$500 bonus for every 10 deals closed within one month

$25 for every cold-sourced lead that attends a scheduled demo



Our service packages typically range from $1,700 to $4,000.



If you can consistently prospect and close, there is serious earning potential here.



What You Will Do:

Build targeted prospect lists using SO Good tools and approved sources

Work and grow a lead database of 3,000+ prospects

Complete 75 to 100+ outbound touches per day

Cold call,
, text, and send DMs

Follow up consistently across every stage

Qualify prospects based on pain, budget, authority, and timing

Run 45 to 60-minute demos with local business owners

Explain rankings, visibility, and revenue opportunities clearly

Handle objections and skepticism

Close deals

Track outreach, demos, follow-ups, and sales in Google Sheets

Keep your pipeline clean and current

Share objections, wins, and market feedback with leadership



You Might Be a Fit If You Are:

Competitive

Persistent

Comfortable hearing "no"

Confident speaking with U.S. business owners

Strong in spoken and written English

Organized with follow-ups

Comfortable with high outbound activity

Self-motivated

Highly accountable

Coachable

Able to follow a proven sales process



You do not need to know everything about local SEO when you start.



You do need to learn fast.



Nice to Have:

B2B sales experience

Cold calling experience

Agency, SaaS, or digital marketing sales experience

Experience selling to local or home-service businesses

Google Business Profile or SEO knowledge

Google Sheets or CRM experience

Loom experience

Remote Work Requirements



This is a fully remote position.



You can work from home, but you must have:



Reliable high-speed internet

A quiet and professional workspace

Reliable computer and headset

Strong English communication skills

Stable availability during your scheduled working hours



Because you will be selling to U.S.-based businesses, you must be comfortable working hours that overlap with the U.S. Central Time business day.



You are expected to be responsive, available, and ready to take calls during your shift.



Who This Is For:

People who hate being average

Closers who want their effort tied directly to their income

Competitive people who like a scoreboard

People who take ownership and do not need constant supervision

Who This Is Not For

Anyone who needs micromanagement

Anyone looking for a guaranteed salary

Anyone who folds after hearing "no"

Anyone uncomfortable with cold outreach



How to Apply:



Do not send us a generic application.



Answer these questions:



Tell us about your previous cold calling or sales experience.

What is the highest number of outbound calls or sales touches you have completed in one day?

Tell us about the hardest product or service you have ever sold.

How do you respond when a prospect tells you "no"?

Why are you willing to work in a commission-only sales position?



Also include a short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you can succeed in this role.

title: Remote Legal Admin – Australian Claims
description:
Important: Read This Before Applying



There are strict instructions on how to apply for this position. If you do not follow the instructions exactly, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.



Your application must include all of the following:



1. Your latest resume.

2. A covering letter explaining why you believe you are suitable for this role.

3. An original Loom video answering the application question at the bottom of this post.



The Loom video must be recorded specifically for this application. Do not send a generic Loom that you have used for other jobs. Do not copy a script or read from a template.



We want to hear how you naturally communicate in English and assess your ability to explain information clearly and professionally.



If your application is missing anything, or if your Loom appears copied, scripted, AI-generated, old or generic, you may not be considered.



About The Role



TPD Matters is looking for a reliable, highly organised and detail-focused Remote Legal Admin to join our Australian legal support team.



We assist clients with Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) claims. Many of our clients are dealing with injuries, illnesses and difficult personal circumstances, so professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy and clear communication are extremely important. This is a hands-on administrative and legal support role focused on helping client files progress efficiently.



You will maintain client files, manage documents and correspondence, complete follow-ups, communicate with clients and external organisations, and ensure tasks are properly recorded and actioned. This role requires someone who takes ownership of their work. You must be able to identify what needs to be done, follow established processes, complete tasks accurately and report back clearly.



What You Will Be Doing



Your responsibilities may include:

- Updating and maintaining client files, records, notes, tasks and follow-ups.

- Assisting with the progression of client matters through the required administrative stages.

- Managing incoming documents, correspondence and client information accurately.

- Saving
s, documents and correspondence to the correct client file.

- Ensuring important correspondence is actioned rather than simply received or filed.

- Creating and updating tasks, reminders and next steps so that required actions are not missed.

- Contacting clients to obtain information, documents, signatures or updates when required.

- Contacting superannuation funds, insurers and other relevant organisations to request information and follow up outstanding matters.

- Following up outstanding requests consistently and escalating delays or issues when appropriate.

- Preparing, sending and following up documents and forms as directed.

- Maintaining accurate and detailed file notes after calls,
s and other actions.

- Working within Actionstep and other CRM/client management systems.

- Communicating clearly with the Sydney team and remote team.

- Following SOPs, checklists, training materials and written instructions.

- Reporting clearly on completed work, outstanding tasks, blockers and matters requiring escalation.

- Handling confidential and sensitive client information carefully and professionally.

- Assisting with other legal administration and file-management tasks as directed.



Performance Expectations

This is a detail-focused and accountability-driven role.



Your success will be measured by the quality and accuracy of your work, your ability to progress tasks efficiently, follow-up consistency, file and CRM accuracy, communication, responsiveness and your ability to follow established processes.



We expect you to:

- Complete assigned tasks accurately and within required timeframes.

- Keep client files, notes, documents and tasks organised and up to date.

- Follow up outstanding matters without needing repeated reminders.

- Record actions clearly so another tea
mber can immediately understand what has occurred and what needs to happen next.

- Properly action incoming
s and correspondence rather than leaving them unattended.

- Escalate problems, delays or uncertainty instead of allowing a matter to sit unresolved.

- Be available and responsive during working hours.

- Communicate clearly when a task is completed, delayed or requires assistance.

- Follow SOPs and instructions consistently.



Accuracy is extremely important. Our team works with legal matters and sensitive client information, so incomplete notes, missed follow-ups, incorrectly saved documents or unactioned correspondence can affect the progression of a client’s matter.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent written and good spoken English.

- Can comfortably work with CRM systems, client files, folders, documents and task lists.

- Is highly organised, reliable and detail-focused.

- Communicates professionally and naturally with Australian clients and stakeholders.

- Has strong administrative skills and can manage multiple files, tasks and follow-ups without losing track of important actions.

- Takes ownership of assigned work and follows tasks through to completion.

- Is confident making professional outbound calls when follow-up is required.

- Is comfortable communicating with clients, insurers, superannuation funds and other organisations.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (AEST/AEDT) Sydney time, unless otherwise agreed.

- Can work independently while still reporting back clearly to the team.

- Is responsive and reliable during working hours.

- Understands the importance of confidentiality when handling sensitive client and legal information.

- Is willing to learn and adapt to Australian legal and administrative processes.

- Experience That Will Be Highly Regarded



Experience in any of the following will be viewed favourably:

- Legal administration.

- Legal assistant or legal clerk work.

- CRM or case-management systems.

- Claims administration or claims support.

- Insurance administration.

- Personal injury or disability claims.

- Client services.

- Australian legal, insurance or professional services businesses.

- Document-heavy administrative roles.

- Roles involving regular client and stakeholder follow-up.



Previous experience with Actionstep is an advantage but is not required. We are more interested in your ability to learn systems quickly, follow processes accurately and maintain high-quality records.



What We Offer

- Full-time remote work with a growing Australian business.

- A structured role with clear SOPs, training and support.

- Training in our systems and processes.

- A stable long-term opportunity for the right person.

- Meaningful work supporting clients who may be going through difficult circumstances.

- Weekly payment in arrears through Wise after onboarding.

- Two weeks of prorated paid time off during the Christmas closedown period.

- Selected Australian public holidays recognised in line with company policy.

- Opportunity to develop strong experience in Australian legal administration and claims processes.

- Long-term opportunity for someone who performs well, communicates clearly and consistently follows the process.

- Application Question For Your Loom Video



Record a short Loom video answering the following scenario:



"Imagine you are assisting with an Australian client’s legal matter. You notice that information requested from an external organisation has still not been received, and the client is also waiting for an update.

Talk us through what you would do next and explain how you would communicate with the client, the external organisation and your internal team."



Please answer naturally, in your own words. Do not read from a script, copy an answer from the internet or use a template.



Final Instruction

To show that you have read the full advert, start the first line of your application with this exact phrase:



TPD Matters Admin



If you do not include this exact phrase at the start of your application, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.

title: Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager – NetSuite
description:
# Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager – NetSuite



**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Work Setup:** Remote / Overseas

**Department:** Accounting & Finance

**Experience:** 3–5+ years

**Primary System:** Oracle NetSuite



## Position Overview



We are looking for a **Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager** to support and help build a structured accounting operation for a growing organization.



The ideal candidate has strong accounting knowledge, hands-on **Oracle NetSuite** experience, management or team-lead experience, and a strong understanding of modern online tools and AI.



This position will play an important role in managing accounting operations, supporting AP and AR functions, working with vendors and customers, training accounting tea
mbers, and developing processes and documentation for a growing remote accounting team.



## Key Responsibilities



### Accounting Operations



* Manage day-to-day accounting activities and ensure transactions are accurately recorded.

* Perform and review journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reports.

* Assist with month-end and year-end closing.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.

* Ensure accounting procedures and internal controls are followed.



### Oracle NetSuite



* Work extensively within **Oracle NetSuite** for accounting and financial operations.

* Maintain and review customer, vendor, and financial records.

* Process and review accounting transactions within NetSuite.

* Help improve NetSuite workflows and accounting processes.

* Support tea
mbers with NetSuite-related questions and processes.

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting tasks.



### Accounts Payable



* Oversee vendor invoices and payment processing.

* Maintain accurate vendor records.

* Review invoices for proper coding, approval, and documentation.

* Monitor outstanding payables and payment schedules.

* Resolve vendor billing discrepancies.

* Help establish standardized AP procedures.



### Accounts Receivable



* Oversee customer invoicing and receivables activities.

* Maintain accurate customer records.

* Monitor outstanding balances and overdue accounts.

* Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies.

* Assist with collections and customer billing issues.

* Establish standardized AR procedures and reporting.



### Vendor & Customer Management



* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of vendors and customers.

* Understand vendor-specific and customer-specific accounting requirements.

* Maintain accurate documentation for important vendor and customer processes.

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve accounting-related issues.

* Ensure important accounting communications are properly documented and escalated.



### Team Management & Training



* Support and manage a remote accounting team.

* Train new accounting employees on accounting procedures, systems, and workflows.

* Develop SOPs, checklists, and training documentation.

* Establish clear responsibilities across accounting functions.

* Review team performance and accounting accuracy.

* Provide guidance on complex accounting issues.

* Help create a repeatable onboarding and training process.



### Automation & AI



* Identify repetitive accounting tasks that can be improved through automation.

* Use AI tools to improve productivity, documentation, research, and workflows.

* Look for opportunities to automate reporting, data entry, communications, and other repetitive tasks.

* Work with management to implement practical automation solutions.

* Stay familiar with modern accounting technology and AI tools.



## Team Structure



The accounting operation may include specialized responsibilities such as:



* **Controller** – Overall accounting leadership, financial oversight, and controls.

* **NetSuite Accounting Specialist** – NetSuite-related accounting operations and system processes.

* **Accounts Payable Specialist** – Vendor invoices, payables, and payment processing.

* **Accounts Receivable Specialist** – Customer billing, receivables, collections, and reconciliation.



The Senior Accountant / Accounting Operations Manager will help establish the processes, documentation, and workflows that allow these functions to operate efficiently.



## Training & Documentation



A key responsibility of this position will be helping establish formal training and documentation for the accounting team.



The candidate will help create:



* Accounting SOPs.

* NetSuite process documentation.

* Vendor-specific procedures.

* Customer-specific procedures.

* AP and AR checklists.

* New employee training materials.

* Recurring accounting task documentation.

* Escalation procedures.

* Internal accounting knowledge resources.



The goal is to create a system where new accounting employees can be trained efficiently without relying solely on informal or undocumented knowledge.



## Communication



The candidate will communicate regularly with management, accounting tea
mbers, vendors, customers, and other internal departments.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills are required.



## Requirements



* **3–5+ years of professional accounting experience.**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

* Experience in a senior accountant, accounting lead, supervisor, or management-level position.

* Hands-on experience with **Oracle NetSuite**.

* Strong understanding of general accounting principles.

* Experience with Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable.

* Experience with account reconciliations and month-end close.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication.

* Strong organizational and documentation skills.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Comfortable working with online business tools and digital systems.

* Ability to work effectively with management, vendors, customers, and accounting tea
mbers.



### Preferred Qualifications



* Experience managing or supervising accounting employees.

* Experience working with U.S.-based accounting processes.

* Advanced Oracle NetSuite experience.

* Experience creating accounting SOPs and training programs.

* Experience working with remote or distributed teams.

* Experience with accounting automation.

* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT.

* CPA, CMA, or equivalent certification is a plus.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is more than a transactional accountant. We are looking for someone who can **take ownership of accounting operations, manage people and processes, work confidently in NetSuite, and help build a scalable accounting system.**



The successful candidate should be:



* Detail-oriented and highly organized.

* Comfortable taking initiative.

* Strong at problem-solving.

* Comfortable managing or mentoring tea
mbers.

* Able to quickly learn new systems and processes.

* Comfortable working with vendors and customers.

* Interested in improving processes through technology and automation.

* Able to create clear documentation and training materials.

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



## Key Performance Indicators



Success in this role will be measured by:



* Accounting accuracy.

* Timeliness of month-end close.

* AP and AR processing accuracy.

* Reconciliation accuracy.

* NetSuite data accuracy.

* Vendor and customer issue resolution.

* Completion and quality of accounting SOPs.

* Training and onboarding effectiveness.

* Team productivity.

* Reduction of repetitive manual accounting work through automation.

title: US Payroll & Accounting Specialist - Full-Time
description:
Hi! I'm Rex. I run Cairn Accounting, a US accounting firm. I'm looking for one careful, reliable person to own payroll processing for our clients. We are looking for a long-term person to grow with the position.



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



Payroll - the core of the role:



- Collect and verify timesheets across multiple clients

- Enter and review hours, rates, deductions, and PTO

- Process payroll runs in Gusto

- Handle new hires, terminations, and status changes

- Track filings and deadlines, and keep a clean log of what's done and what's open

- Quarterly and year-end items - W-2s, 1099s, agency notices



Light accounting support:



- Account reconciliations

- Basic transaction categorization

- General data entry and record maintenance

- Month-end cleanup items



Beyond the routine:



- Building one-off reports and summaries when a client or project needs something no template covers

- Investigating discrepancies between systems that should agree

- Researching and resolving agency notices

- Documenting the processes you run so they stay repeatable



Most weeks follow a steady rhythm, and I want to be upfront about that - this is precise, repeatable work. But it isn't only that. Some requests arrive with no template and no SOP, and I'll need you to work out what's actually being asked, find the data, build it, and check it before it comes back to me.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



- Real US payroll experience. Any platform - Gusto, ADP, Paychex, Rippling, QuickBooks Payroll.

- Comfort with US payroll basics: withholdings, multi-state situations, quarterly filings, W-2 and 1099 season.

- Working knowledge of bookkeeping fundamentals - reconciliations, categorization, and how payroll lands in the books.

- Genuinely strong Excel or Google Sheets. Lookups, pivots, and the patience to reconcile two lists that should match and don't.

- Clear written English - enough to ask me a precise question rather than guess.

- Reliable internet and power, with a backup plan. Payroll deadlines don't move.

- Comfort saying "I'm not sure, let me check" instead of filling in a blank.



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED



- QuickBooks Online beyond payroll

- Experience across multiple client companies rather than a single employer

- Month-end close experience



THE DETAILS



Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week, salaried.



Rate: $1,000-1,200 USD per month depending on experience, paid semi-monthly.



Hours: Flexible, you set your own schedule. The exception is payroll processing days, when I need you reachable within a few hours so we can fix problems before deadlines. Overlap with US Pacific mornings is a plus, not a requirement.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Health care reimbursement

- 12 paid holidays per year

- Two weeks paid vacation per year



HOW TO APPLY



1. Use exactly 27 Apply Points on your application.



2. Make your subject line exactly:



BLUE CAIRN



3. Answer these four questions, numbered, in this order. Short answers. Attach your resume separately rather than pasting it into the message.



- Which payroll platforms have you worked in, and roughly how many employees or clients were you handling at your busiest?



- Tell me about a payroll error you caught before it went out - or one you caught after. What was it, and how did you find it?



- What's your Excel or Sheets comfort level? Give me one specific thing you've built or fixed, not a rating out of ten.



- A client asks you for a report that doesn't exist in any system, and there's no template. What are your first two steps?



4. At the very end, on its own line, write your expected monthly rate and your earliest start date, like this: $1100 / Sept 1



- Rex

title: AMAZON FBA ACCOUNT MANAGER / PRODUCT-SOURCING VA
description:
I am looking for an experienced Amazon FBA virtual assistant who can operate and grow my Amazon seller account from A–Z.



My involvement should be limited to:



Approving and paying for inventory and necessary business expenses.

Signing important supplier or legal documents.

Completing identity verification when Amazon requires the account owner.

Giving final approval before inventory is purchased.



The VA will be responsible for everything else described below.



POSITION REQUIREMENTS



You must have proven experience managing a US Amazon Seller Central account. You must understand wholesale sourcing, online arbitrage, FBA, product restrictions, supplier verification, profitability analysis, inventory management and account health.



You must be able to communicate clearly in English, provide organized reports and work without constant supervision.



PRODUCT RESEARCH



You will be responsible for:



Finding profitable, replenishable products.

Searching for products from legitimate wholesalers, distributors and brands.

Checking the exact ASIN, UPC, variation, size, quantity and condition.

Confirming that my seller account is eligible to sell each product.

Identifying category, brand, ASIN and condition restrictions.

Checking whether Amazon sells the product.

Checking sales rank, estimated monthly sales and sales history.

Reviewing Keepa history, Buy Box history and price stability.

Checking the number of FBA and FBM sellers.

Checking whether the listing is dominated by Amazon, the brand or one seller.

Identifying possible intellectual-property, counterfeit or authenticity risks.

Checking expiration dates, hazmat status, meltable restrictions and special preparation requirements.

Avoiding products with unstable prices, excessive competition or frequent listing problems.

Avoiding products with high return rates or compliance risks.



Every product recommendation must include:



Product name and exact ASIN.

Amazon listing link.

Supplier name and product link.

Supplier’s contact information.

Unit purchase cost.

Minimum order quantity.

Shipping cost to Amazon or a preparation center.

Amazon referral and FBA fees.

Expected selling price.

Net profit per unit.

Profit margin.

ROI.

Estimated monthly sales.

Recommended order quantity.

Number of competing sellers.

Buy Box and price history.

Restrictions and risks.

Confirmation that my account can sell the exact product.

Screenshot or supporting evidence for important figures.



My preferred minimum targets are:



At least $5 estimated net profit per unit.

At least 25% ROI after all known costs.

Stable selling-price history.

Enough sales to support the recommended order quantity.

No purchase recommendation based only on temporary price spikes.



A product that meets these numbers is not automatically approved. You must wait for my written approval before placing any order.



SUPPLIER SOURCING AND COMMUNICATION



You will be responsible for:



Finding legitimate US brands, authorized wholesalers and distributors.

Verifying supplier contact information and business legitimacy.

Contacting suppliers by
 or telephone.

Opening wholesale accounts using information I authorize.

Completing applications for me to review and sign.

Requesting catalogs, price lists, invoices, authorization letters and account terms.

Negotiating prices, minimum orders and shipping terms when possible.

Confirming that the supplier permits resale on Amazon.

Maintaining professional relationships with suppliers.

Organizing supplier records, invoices and correspondence.

Following up with suppliers about inventory and pricing.

Never using fake, edited, purchased or unverifiable invoices.



You may prepare purchase orders, but you may not place or pay for an order without my written approval.



UNGATING AND COMPLIANCE



You will be responsible for:



Checking whether approval is required before recommending a product.

Identifying Amazon’s exact ungating requirements.

Obtaining legitimate invoices and supporting documents from authorized suppliers.

Preparing and submitting applications when authorized.

Monitoring applications and responding to Amazon’s requests.

Keeping copies of every document submitted.

Never altering invoices, documents or product photographs.

Never submitting false information to Amazon.

Never buying inventory until eligibility and documentation requirements have been reviewed.



LISTING MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for:



Matching products to the correct existing ASIN.

Verifying that the physical product exactly matches the listing.

Creating and maintaining offers.

Setting SKUs, prices and fulfillment channels.

Preventing duplicate listings.

Monitoring suppressed, stranded and inactive listings.

Resolving listing errors and catalog problems.

Opening and following up on Seller Support cases.

Maintaining accurate inventory and pricing.

Never changing an existing product detail page in a misleading way.

Never creating bundles, multipacks or variations that violate Amazon policy.



FBA SHIPMENT MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for:



Creating FBA shipment plans.

Preparing product, labeling and packaging instructions.

Coordinating with suppliers or a preparation center.

Confirming carton contents, weights and measurements.

Generating FNSKU and shipping labels.

Tracking shipments until they are received.

Investigating shortages, damaged inventory and receiving discrepancies.

Opening reimbursement cases when appropriate.

Monitoring stranded, unfulfillable and aged inventory.

Recommending removal or liquidation when necessary.



PRICING AND INVENTORY



You will be responsible for:



Monitoring Buy Box eligibility and price changes.

Managing repricing within approved minimum and maximum prices.

Protecting the account from selling below the required profit level.

Tracking inventory levels and sales velocity.

Preparing restock recommendations.

Preventing unnecessary storage and aged-inventory fees.

Identifying products that should be reordered, paused or discontinued.

Never ordering or committing to inventory without my approval.



ACCOUNT HEALTH AND CUSTOMER SERVICE



You will be responsible for:



Monitoring Account Health every business day.

Monitoring policy notifications, performance notifications and compliance requests.

Responding promptly to buyer messages.

Managing returns, refunds and customer-service issues according to Amazon policy.

Investigating negative feedback and requesting removal only when allowed.

Preparing responses and plans of action for my review when necessary.

Reporting serious account warnings to me immediately.

Keeping late-shipment, cancellation and defect metrics within Amazon’s requirements.

Never manipulating reviews, feedback, rankings or sales.

Never contacting customers for prohibited reasons.



FINANCIAL AND PERFORMANCE REPORTING



You will provide a weekly report showing:



Gross sales.

Amazon fees.

Cost of goods.

Shipping and preparation costs.

Refunds and returns.

Advertising expenses, if applicable.

Estimated net profit.

Profit by ASIN.

Inventory value.

Inventory in stock, inbound and stranded.

Recommended reorders.

Products losing money.

Account-health issues.

Supplier outreach completed.

New products researched.

Open Seller Support cases.

Tasks completed and tasks still pending.



All numbers must account for Amazon fees, product cost, inbound shipping, preparation, labeling, storage and other known expenses.



ACCOUNT ACCESS AND SECURITY



You will receive your own authorized Seller Central secondary-user access. You will not receive my primary login.



You must:



Use your own authorized user profile.

Enable two-step verification.

Keep all business information confidential.

Use only the permissions necessary for your job.

Never change the primary account owner.

Never change banking, deposit, tax, legal-entity or credit-card information.

Never add another user without my written approval.

Never share access with another person.

Never install software or connect third-party services without approval.

Never download or distribute customer information.

Never make purchases or transfer money.

Never represent yourself as the legal owner of the business.

Immediately report any suspected security issue.



Any unauthorized sharing of account information or access will result in immediate termination.



PROHIBITED METHODS



The following are strictly prohibited:



Fake, altered or borrowed invoices.

Counterfeit or questionable inventory.

Buying from unauthorized sources while claiming they are distributors.

Review manipulation.

Search manipulation or artificial orders.

Multiple-account schemes.

Using customer information outside Amazon.

Misrepresenting products or product condition.

Listing against the wrong ASIN.

Sending used, damaged or expired products as new.

Using black-hat tactics.

Making guarantees about profits or sales.

Purchasing inventory without my approval.

Hiding losses, warnings, suspensions or supplier problems.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



Please provide:



Number of years managing Amazon accounts.

Marketplaces you have managed.

Whether you specialize in wholesale, online arbitrage or private label.

Examples of products you researched and managed.

Tools you use, such as Keepa, SellerAmp, Jungle Scout or Helium 10.

An example of your product-analysis spreadsheet.

An example of a weekly performance report.

Your process for verifying suppliers.

Your process for checking restrictions and intellectual-property risks.

References from previous Amazon clients, if available.

Your requested hourly or monthly rate.

Your available working hours and time zone.

Confirmation that you will not subcontract the work without permission.



PAID TEST PROJECT



Before receiving ongoing account access, you will complete a small paid test.



The test will require you to:



Find three legitimate wholesale or replenishable product opportunities.

Verify the suppliers.

Check whether my account can sell the exact ASINs.

Provide complete cost, fee, sales, competition, profit and ROI calculations.

Contact at least one supplier professionally, if authorized.

Explain the major risks associated with each product.

Recommend whether I should buy or reject each product.



Passing the test does not guarantee long-term employment. Accuracy, honesty, communication and the quality of your research will determine whether you are hired.



WORKING EXPECTATIONS



Provide regular updates without being reminded.

Document all work in a shared spreadsheet or project-management system.

Keep supplier
s and documents organized.

Ask for approval before spending money or making a major account decision.

Notify me immediately about account-health or compliance issues.

Never hide mistakes.

Follow Amazon’s current policies at all times.

Protect long-term account health ahead of short-term sales.



When applying, begin your response with the words “Amazon Account Manager” so I know you read the complete requirements.

title: Investor Relations Coordinator
description:

Gride Technology is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and relationship-driven Investor Relations Coordinator to lead communications and engagement with current and prospective investors. This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for investor communications, fundraising coordination, shareholder engagement, and investor events while helping build long-term confidence in Gride’s vision and growth.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator, highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with executives, business leaders, and high-net-worth individuals.

Key Responsibilities

Investor Relations

• Serve as the primary liaison between Gride and its investors.

• Maintain regular communication with current and prospective investors.

• Coordinate investor meetings, conference calls, and presentations.

• Respond promptly to investor inquiries and information requests.

• Build and maintain long-term investor relationships.

Fundraising Support

• Assist in planning and executing fundraising campaigns.

• Coordinate investor outreach initiatives.

• Maintain an accurate investor pipeline and CRM database.

• Schedule follow-up meetings with prospective investors.

• Track commitments and investment milestones.

Communications

Reporting & Administration

• Support executive leadership with meeting preparation and follow-up.

• Ensure compliance with company policies regarding confidential information.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in investor relations, fundraising, business development, account management, or client relationship management.

Required Skills

• Strong presentation and interpersonal abilities.

• Professional telephone etiquette.

• Excellent networking and relationship-building skills.

• High level of organization and attention to detail.

• Strong time management and multitasking abilities.

• Knowledge of startup financing and corporate governance.

• Experience planning executive meetings and investor events.

• Multilingual skills (English plus French, Spanish, or Haitian Creole) are a plus.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Investor response time within 24 hours.

• Investor satisfaction and engagement.

• Number of qualified investor meetings scheduled.

• Investor retention and relationship growth.

• Accuracy and timeliness of investor communications.

• CRM database maintained at 100?curacy.

We are looking for someone who is:

• Highly organized and proactive.

• Personable and relationship-focused.

• Confident communicating with executives and investors.

• Strategic, resourceful, and solution-oriented.

• Self-motivated with a strong work ethic.

• Passionate about innovation, entrepreneurship, and helping grow a technology company.

title: VA - Operations Specialist
description:
Virtual Assistant – Operations Specialist

(Path to Operations Manager)



We're looking for an Operations-focused Virtual Assistant to take ownership of the systems that keep our business running — logistics, procurement, workflows, and projects. This isn't a task-taking VA role. We're hiring someone who can think several steps ahead, spot what's broken before it breaks, and eventually step into a managerial position overseeing this function.



If you're the kind of person who color-codes your own to-do list without being asked, this is for you.



A note on scope: this role is deliberately focused. We have specialists in-house handling graphic design, social media,
 management, and appointment setting — so you won't be pulled into those areas. Your time is protected for operations, systems, and process work.



What You'll Own



Logistics & Shipments



Coordinate inbound/outbound shipments, track orders, and troubleshoot delays before they become problems

Liaise with couriers, freight partners, and suppliers to keep goods moving on schedule



Business Systems



Maintain and improve the tools and platforms we rely on daily (CRM, inventory, project management software, etc.)

Identify gaps in our current systems and propose better ways of doing things



Procurement



Source suppliers, negotiate terms, and manage purchase orders

Track inventory needs and reorder points so we never run short



Project Management



Keep cross-functional projects on track — timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups

Manage website builds and software projects end-to-end, coordinating developers, designers, and other contractors

Turn loose ideas into structured plans with clear next steps



Internal Workflows & AI Adoption



Document and refine how work gets done across the team

Build repeatable processes that reduce friction and save time

Champion the adoption of AI tools across our workflows — identify where automation and AI can save time, then implement it

Stay on top of new AI tools and bring recommendations to the table proactively

Who We're Looking For

Independent — you don't need hand-holding; you take a goal and figure out how to get there

Proactive — you flag issues and bring solutions, not just problems

A natural leader — you're comfortable guiding others, even before you have the title

Empathetic — you understand people, not just processes, and build trust with the team and vendors alike

Exceptionally organised — nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

Mastery-level English, written and spoken

Spreadsheet fluency is essential — comfortable building and managing complex spreadsheets (formulas, dashboards, tracking systems)

"Vibe coding" experience (building/prototyping with AI coding tools) is highly desirable

Based in the Philippines, working primarily in GMT+10 (Australian Eastern Time) hours

AI-fluent — you already use AI tools in your daily work and are excited to bring that mindset to how the whole team operates

Comfortable managing website builds or software projects, even without a technical background



Prior experience in operations, logistics, procurement, project coordination, or website/software project management is a strong plus — but mindset matters more than a perfect resume.



Work Setup

Remote, based in the Philippines

Working hours: 35 hours per week, primarily aligned with GMT+10 (Australian Eastern Time)

You'll be working alongside and, as the role grows, helping guide our Filipino-based tea
mbers

Growth Path



This role is designed to grow. As you prove out ownership of these areas, there's a clear path toward an Operations Manager position with expanded responsibility, a growing team under you, and long-term career prospects with the company.



How to Apply



Reply to this ad with a personalised
 — no generic cover letters. Tell us:



Why you're a great fit for this specific position

An example (or examples) of an operational change you've implemented that led to real, measurable success

title: Senior Roofing Estimator – Australian Roofing Experience
description:
Part-Time | Remote



We are looking for an experienced and Senior Roofing Estimator to join our team on a part-time, fully remote basis.



We're specifically looking for someone with strong hands-on experience estimating Australian roofing projects. This is not a general estimating position or for junior estimators — roofing experience is essential.



Minimum Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years' experience estimating Australian roofing projects

- Strong experience completing detailed roofing takeoffs and estimates

- Good understanding of Australian roofing plans, specifications and construction details

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Reliable and able to consistently meet deadlines

- Good written and spoken English

- Available for part-time remote work

- Senior Roofing Experience***



You should be confident estimating items such as:



- Metal roof sheeting

- Flashings and cappings

- Gutters and downpipes

- Fascia

- Valleys

- Roof penetrations and accessories

- Insulation and roof-related components

- Material quantities and wastage



Experience across residential, commercial and architectural roofing projects will be highly regarded.



Software



Experience with takeoff and estimating software is required.



Experience using roofing-specific takeoff or estimating software will be considered a strong advantage.



Please include the software you have used and your level of experience with each.



The Role



You'll be responsible for reviewing project documentation, completing roofing takeoffs and preparing estimates for Australian roofing contractors.



The role is:



- Part-time

- 100% remote

- Ongoing for the right person

- Focused specifically on Australian roofing projects



We're looking for someone who already understands roofing estimating and can become productive quickly rather than someone who needs to be trained in the fundamentals.



To Apply



Please include:

mber who understands the current workflow
