title: AI Creative Designer / Motion Graphics Editor
description:
# AI Creative Designer / Motion Graphics Editor — ChatGPT + Claude Expert



We’re looking for a **seriously talented AI Creative Designer / Motion Graphics Editor** to create high-end product advertisements and creative assets for our brands.



This is **not** a beginner position, and I’m not looking for someone who just learned how to generate AI videos last week.



I need someone who understands **creative direction, motion graphics, product advertising, branding, composition, lighting, realism, and AI prompting** at a professional level.



### What You’ll Create



* High-end product advertisements

* Realistic product visuals

* Motion graphics

* Product animations

* Social media ad creatives

* Instagram Reels / TikTok ads

* Product launch creatives

* Static AI product advertisements

* Short-form commercial-style videos



The goal is simple:



**Your work should look like a real brand paid a real creative agency to make it.**



Not cheap AI content.

Not random generations.

Not products floating around with crazy transitions.

Not obviously AI-generated garbage.



### AI EXPERIENCE



You should be VERY comfortable using:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Advanced prompting / prompt engineering

* AI image generation

* AI video generation

* Photoshop

* After Effects

* Premiere Pro

* Motion graphics and compositing



Knowing additional professional AI tools is a huge plus.



### PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



I’m going to save both of us some time.



**If your main workflow is throwing a product into Higgsfield and calling it an advertisement, this job is not for you.**



I’m not looking for template-style AI videos where everything looks the same.



I need somebody who can actually **think creatively, build a concept, control the AI, composite things correctly, fix mistakes, animate professionally and make the final product believable.**



And respectfully:



**If your work isn’t good, don’t waste your time applying.**



I’m looking for professional shit.



I have high standards for creatives and I will notice the small details — bad shadows, warped packaging, incorrect logos, messed-up typography, unrealistic movement, weird AI artifacts, bad lighting and lazy editing.



If you’re actually good at what you do, though, **this could turn into consistent long-term work.**



### What I Want



I should be able to send you:



**1. The product**

**2. The brand assets**

**3. A rough idea or direction**



And you should be able to take it from there.



I do NOT want to explain every frame.



You should be able to look at a product and think:



**“How can I make an ad for this that actually looks sick?”**



Then execute it.



### Attention to Detail Is EXTREMELY Important



The product needs to remain accurate.



That means:



* Correct logo

* Correct packaging

* Correct colors

* Correct proportions

* Correct product text

* Realistic shadows

* Realistic reflections

* Professional typography

* Clean animation

* Consistent branding



AI is a tool.



**I need someone who knows how to control the tool — not someone letting the AI control the creative.**



### When Applying



Send me:



* Your portfolio

* Your **3 BEST product advertisements**

* Your best motion graphics work

* Your best AI advertisement

* What AI tools you use

* Your experience with ChatGPT

* Your experience with Claude

* Your After Effects experience

* Your hourly or monthly rate



**Please do NOT send me 30 average projects.**



Give me your **3 strongest pieces.**



If those aren't good, I'm probably not going through the rest of the portfolio.



### PAID TEST



There will most likely be a paid test before hiring.



I’ll provide you with a real product and some creative direction.



I want to see how you:



* Develop the concept

* Prompt the AI

* Preserve the actual product

* Build the environment

* Add motion

* Fix AI mistakes

* Polish the final creative



### HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



**“I ACTUALLY READ THIS”**



Then answer:



1. What AI tools do you use?

2. How do you use ChatGPT and Claude in your workflow?

3. What software do you use for motion graphics?

4. Send your 3 BEST product advertisements.

5. Send your best AI-generated advertisement.

6. What is your hourly or monthly rate?



If you’re **actually talented, creative, obsessive about details, and know how to make AI creatives look REAL**, I want to see your work.



If you’re planning on sending me basic Higgsfield generations and hoping I don’t notice...



**Save the application. ????**

title: Marketing Coordinator – Paid Media & Account-Based Marketing
description:
I am looking for a Part-Time Marketing Coordinator who is organized, analytical, proactive, and comfortable working across digital advertising, reporting, and account-based marketing (ABM).



This position will initially require approximately 4–6 hours per week, with the possibility of expanding the role and weekly hours over time based on projects and upcoming marketing initiatives.



This role will primarily serve as a marketing support and advisory position. You will not necessarily have direct access to or be responsible for managing the paid advertising platforms. Instead, I am looking for someone who can help me review performance, conduct research, make recommendations, develop strategies, and guide me through the implementation of campaigns and optimizations across Google Ads, Google Search, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, 6sense, and Salesforce.

The ideal candidate is someone who can look at the bigger picture, identify opportunities, explain what should be adjusted or implemented, and provide clear guidance on next steps.

Key Responsibilities

Advise on campaign structure, targeting, keywords, audiences, messaging, budgets, and optimization opportunities.

Review existing segmentation and suggest improvements based on campaign objectives and business priorities.

Candidates do not need to be experts in every platform, but should be familiar with the ABM process and comfortable advising on best practices, processes, and potential improvements.



Marketing Strategy & Campaign Briefs

Create clear and organized marketing and campaign briefs outlining campaign objectives, target audiences, messaging, channels, KPIs, timelines, and recommendations.

Help develop marketing strategies for campaigns, target segments, and priority accounts.

Recommend campaign approaches based on research, customer insights, business goals, and historical performance.

Help translate broader marketing goals into actionable campaign plans and next steps.

Provide strategic feedback and recommendations before campaigns are implemented.



What I’m Looking For

Experience or strong familiarity with Google Ads, Google Search, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads.

Experience with or familiarity with 6sense and Salesforce, particularly segmentation, account lists, and ABM processes.

Strong working knowledge of Excel, including the ability to organize campaign data and create clear performance dashboards.

Comfortable interpreting marketing metrics, KPIs, and campaign-performance data.

Strong research and analytical skills.



Ability to turn data and research into specific, actionable recommendations.

Experience creating marketing briefs, campaign plans, or marketing strategies.

Ability to explain recommendations clearly and guide someone through implementation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

Comfortable working independently within a limited number of weekly hours and prioritizing the highest-impact activities.

Proactive and comfortable suggesting improvements, new ideas, and alternative approaches.



Nice to Have

Experience working in B2B marketing or Account-Based Marketing (ABM).

Experience supporting sales and marketing alignment around target accounts and pipeline initiatives.

Knowledge of lead generation, demand generation, and paid media strategy.

Experience analyzing campaign performance across multiple advertising platforms.

Familiarity with marketing funnels, attribution, audience targeting, and conversion optimization.

Experience advising or consulting on paid media campaigns without necessarily being the person directly managing the advertising accounts.

Time Commitment

This is a part-time position starting at approximately 4–6 hours per week.

Because of the limited initial hours, I am looking for someone who can work efficiently, quickly understand what needs attention, and focus on the activities that will have the greatest marketing impact.

There is potential for the position to expand in scope and hours as my marketing programs and needs grow.



The Ideal Person

I am looking for someone who can act as a thought partner and marketing advisor, not simply someone waiting for tasks to be assigned.



You should be comfortable reviewing what I am currently doing, conducting research, analyzing campaign performance, identifying opportunities, and then coming back with clear recommendations on what should be done, why it should be done, and how to implement it.



You will not be expected to directly manage all of the advertising platforms. Instead, I am looking for someone who can help guide me through the strategy and implementation process, review what has been set up, and recommend adjustments when needed.



You don’t need to know everything on day one, but you should be resourceful, comfortable learning new processes, and able to think strategically about how marketing efforts can continuously improve.

I'm hiring ONE appointment setter who ALREADY KNOWS THIS INDUSTRY to cold call HR Directors, CFOs, and Controllers and book 15-minute introductory meetings on my calendar.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING: This post is only for candidates with real experience in US employee benefits or group health insurance. That means you have done at least ONE of the following:



Cold called or set appointments for a US benefits broker, benefits agency, or insurance brokerage (group health, ancillary, or voluntary benefits)

Set appointments or sold for a PEO, TPA, or payroll/HR services company (ADP, Paychex, Gusto, Insperity, or similar)

Worked a US health insurance account at a BPO or call center (enrollment, member services, provider relations, or broker support) AND have separate B2B cold calling experience

Worked in licensing or back-office support for a US benefits agency (quoting, RFPs, renewals, census work) AND have separate B2B cold calling experience



If none of those describe you, please do not apply. I have a separate posting for general B2B appointment setters. Applications without benefits experience will be deleted.



Why I'm requiring this: You will be talking to HR Directors and CFOs about their group health renewal. When a prospect says "we're self-funded," or "our renewal came in at 18%," or "we already work with a broker on our medical and a different one on ancillary," I need you to understand what that means and respond intelligently, not freeze or read the wrong script branch. At this level, industry knowledge is the difference between a booked meeting and a hang-up.



What you'll do:



Call from a lead list I provide (company, contact name, title, direct phone). No list building required.

Open conversations with HR and Finance decision-makers about their upcoming benefits renewal

Handle industry-specific objections credibly. A script and objection guide are provided, but you'll have latitude because you know the space.

Book qualified meetings into my calendar (Calendly) and send confirmation
s (template provided)

Log every call outcome in a tracking sheet and give me a 5-minute end-of-shift summary

Schedule:



6 to 10 hours per week to start, split across 3 or 4 days

US business hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM Arizona time (MST), which is roughly 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM Philippine time. This is a NIGHT SHIFT role. Only apply if you already work nights or can genuinely commit to it.

Consistent performers grow into 15 to 20+ hours per week and a higher per-appointment bonus.



Requirements:



Verifiable US employee benefits or group insurance experience per the list above. I will check, so be ready to name the company, the account, and what you actually did.

At least 1 year of B2B cold calling or appointment setting for US clients

Excellent spoken English with a clear, confident, executive-appropriate phone presence

Call script, objection guide, and voi

US phone number and dialer at no cost to you

title: Estimator and PreConstruction
description:
Who We Are

Schamber Company is a $50M residential and multifamily electrical contracting company based in Corona, California. We perform approximately 4,000 homes annually across Southern California for major builders including Lennar, DR Horton, and Meritage Homes, as well as multifamily developers like Western National Construction.

Our business operates in a high-volume, builder-driven environment where estimating discipline, pricing accuracy, value engineering (VE), and clean handoffs directly impact margin, builder trust, field execution, and revenue realization. Errors or gaps in preconstruction do not stay in preconstruction — they affect Operations, job cost integrity, purchasing, scheduling, and profitability.

We operate with discipline across six KPI categories: 

• People

• Quality & Service

• Finance

• Growth

• Efficiency

• Technology

This role sits at the front end of that system. The Preconstruction Manager protects margin before work is awarded, turns builder opportunities into complete and supportable proposal packages, and ensures Operations receives the scope, assumptions, pricing, VE decisions, and documentation needed to execute without avoidable confusion.

Who You Are to Us

This is not a basic estimating role.

You are responsible for making sure Schamber Company pursues, prices, clarifies, and hands off builder opportunities with discipline — without margin leakage, scope confusion, or avoidable operational risk.

You serve as the control point between builder opportunities, estimating execution, value engineering, pricing governance, and Operations readiness.

You operate in a high-volume, builder-specific preconstruction environment that requires strict scope discipline, accurate takeoffs, current pricing, documented assumptions, clean VE presentation, and persistent follow-through from bid intake through award handoff.

You do not control awarded-job execution — you control the quality, accuracy, and completeness of what Operations receives before execution begins.

Core Role Outcomes

• All active bids have aligned estimating resources before work begins

• Single-family estimates are complete, accurate, and supported by scope, assumptions, takeoffs, VE options, and pricing documentation

• Bid clarifications are answered within 24 hours

• Pricing standards, margin floors, and exception escalation rules are enforced

• Vendor pricing terms are negotiated, documented, and kept current

• Value engineering packages are builder-ready, clearly presented, and supported by documented decisions

• Awarded jobs are handed off to Operations with complete estimating packages and PM receipt confirmation

• No margin is lost due to missed scope, outdated pricing, poor documentation, or handoff breakdowns

What You’ll Do

1. Estimating Leadership and Bid Coordination

• Coordinate estimating resources for active bids.

• Ensure estimating resources are aligned to active bid opportunities on a per-bid basis.

• Direct the bid preparation workflow so estimating work is timely, complete, and focused on current priorities.

• Work with the SF Estimator where specifically assigned for estimating, VE, and handoff execution support.

• Escalate resource conflicts, pricing exceptions, margin concerns, or quality issues to the President.

2. Proposal Development, Takeoffs, and Scope Clarity

• Execute complete single-family bid preparation, including takeoff and estimate development.

• Prepare model home estimates for model home opportunities.

• Develop VE alternatives for bid opportunities when supported by the scope.

• Respond to bid clarifications within 24 hours.

• Document scope, assumptions, pricing basis, and clarifications so the proposal package is builder-ready and internally usable.

• Ensure single-family estimates are complete, accurate, and clearly supported before submission or handoff.

3. Pricing, Margin, and Vendor Cost Governance

• Own standards and enforcement for margin discipline across all bids.

• Ensure pricing standards and margin floors are met before bid submission.

• Escalate pricing, margin, and exception issues to the President.

• Maintain current estimating templates and pricing tables in SharePoint with version control.

• Negotiate vendor pricing and document terms in the vendor pricing terms repository quarterly and as needed.

• Review options, assemblies, and sales office pricing annually and whenever significant cost changes occur.

• Ensure all pricing reflects current costs and margin requirements.

• Document annual pricing audits for options, assemblies, and sales office pricing.

4. Value Engineering Standards and Builder Presentation

• Own standards and enforcement for value engineering consistency, delivery quality, and client-ready presentation.

• Review builder plans for value engineering opportunities.

• Prepare marked-up plans, VE notes pages, and client packages.

• Present VE packages to builders.

• Document builder decisions and VE outcomes.

• Audit VE delivery quality per project and during quarterly reviews.

• Escalate VE quality or exception issues to the President.

5. Sales-to-Operations Handoff and Award Documentation

• Coordinate handoff of awarded jobs from Sales to Operations.

• Deliver the estimating package to the Project Manager upon single-family tract award.

• Ensure the handoff includes the estimate, plans, scope clarifications, assumptions, VE decisions, and relevant pricing documentation.

• Obtain PM confirmation that the estimating package was received.

• Make sure awarded jobs move into Operations with complete documentation and no avoidable scope confusion.

6. Preconstruction Process Control, Documentation, and Escalation

• Keep current templates, pricing tables, and estimating standards organized and version controlled in SharePoint.

• Maintain documented VE standards and enforce consistent deliverable quality.

• Document vendor pricing terms and keep the pricing repository current.

• Use PiecePrices, pricing tables, estimating templates, marked-up plans, VE notes pages, client packages, builder plans, bid clarifications, and scope/assumptions documentation as supported by the preconstruction workflow.

• Escalate exceptions involving pricing, margin, VE quality, cost changes, or handoff completeness to the President.

• Review pricing and margin governance quarterly and maintain ongoing compliance.

What You Do NOT Do

• At launch, this role includes SF Estimator responsibilities because Schamber Company does not currently have a dedicated SF Estimator. As the company grows, we plan to hire a dedicated SF Estimator so this role can shift toward managing and directing that function rather than personally executing all SF estimating work.

• You do not own operational execution after handoff — Project Managers own execution once the awarded-job package is received

• You do not bypass pricing standards, margin floors, documentation requirements, or version control to move faster

• You do not approve unsupported pricing exceptions — exceptions are escalated to the President

• You do not assume multifamily estimating ownership unless Schamber Company specifically assigns that responsibility

• You do not make final executive pricing, margin, or strategic sales decisions without President oversight where exceptions are involved

Skills & Requirements

Required

• Strong estimating, pricing, and construction preconstruction discipline.

• Ability to coordinate estimating resources across active bid opportunities.

• Ability to prepare or manage complete single-family bid packages, including takeoffs, estimates, VE options, bid clarifications, scope, and assumptions.

• Strong margin discipline and ability to enforce pricing standards.

• Ability to communicate clearly with builders, internal sales/preconstruction resources, Project Managers, and the President.

• Experience using or managing estimating tools, pricing tables, templates, and version-controlled documentation.

• Strong documentation habits and follow-through.

• Ability to escalate exceptions clearly with facts, risk, and proposed direction.

Preferred

• Experience with single-family tract estimating and builder proposal packages.

• Experience with value engineering presentation packages, marked-up plans, VE notes, and builder-facing recommendations.

• Experience with SharePoint-based estimating templates, pricing tables, and version control.

• Experience using Excel, Accubid, or similar estimating/pricing systems.

• Experience negotiating vendor pricing and documenting cost terms.

Culture Requirements — Non-Negotiable

• No-excuse ownership: you identify pricing, scope, margin, VE, and handoff issues early, resolve what you own, and escalate clearly when needed

• Direct communicator: clear, timely, fact-based communication with builders, estimating resources, Project Managers, and leadership

• Working Genius profile: assessment required as part of hiring process

• High accountability standard — you treat estimating accuracy, margin protection, documentation quality, and handoff completeness as personal responsibilities

• Process discipline: templates, pricing tables, SharePoint version control, VE standards, and documented assumptions are mandatory

KPIs for the Role

KPI Target Measured By

Bid Estimating Resource Alignment Estimating resources aligned for each active bid Bid schedule, resource plan, and active bid review

Complete and Accurate SF Estimates SF estimates completed with takeoff, pricing, scope, assumptions, and VE options where applicable Estimate package review and bid file documentation

Bid Clarification Response Time Responses completed within 24 hours Bid clarification log and builder communication timestamps

Scope and Assumption Documentation Scope and assumptions documented for every bid package Bid file review and proposal package checklist

VE Package Delivery and Decision Documentation VE package delivered, presented, and decisions documented per VE request VE package file, builder presentation record, and decision log

Pricing and Margin Standard Compliance Pricing standards and margin floors met or exceptions escalated Pricing review, margin check, and exception escalation record

SharePoint Template and Pricing Table Version Control Current templates and pricing tables maintained and version controlled SharePoint file review and quarterly governance check

Vendor Pricing Repository Updates Vendor pricing terms updated quarterly and as needed Vendor pricing terms repository and quarterly review record

Sales-to-Ops Handoff Completion Complete estimating package delivered to PM with receipt confirmation per award Handoff checklist, package file, and PM confirmation

Annual Pricing Audit Completion Options, assemblies, and sales office pricing reviewed annually and after significant cost changes Annual pricing audit documentation and cost-change review log



Compensation & Benefits

• Base salary range: $65,000–$95,000, depending on experience, estimating ability, construction knowledge, and ability to own the combined Preconstruction Manager / SF Estimator responsibilities at launch

• Health insurance

• 401(k) match

• Paid holidays

• Paid time off

• Sick time

• Dental and vision insurance

• Company phone or phone allowance

• Mileage reimbursement or vehicle allowance for approved business travel, if applicable

• Performance bonus eligibility

Growth Path

This role is designed as the management foundation for Schamber Company’s preconstruction function.

As the company grows, adds estimating capacity, or opens new divisions and geographic markets, this role can expand from Preconstruction Manager into Director of Preconstruction and ultimately VP of Preconstruction.

The growth path is tied to building and leading the preconstruction team, standardizing estimating and value engineering (VE) across divisions, improving bid discipline, protecting margin before work is awarded, and creating clean handoffs into Operations.

We promote from within when the track record is there. This is how you build it.

title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description:
We’re hiring our first dedicated Dispatcher to support our growing operations, particularly on a network of autonomous vehicles and food-delivery robots across U.S. markets. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day dispatch including monitoring live fleet operations, coordinating with field teams, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and helping build dispatch workflows that will support the operation as it scales. 



You’ll be working across multiple systems and communication channels, keeping track of what’s happening across different markets and jumping in when something needs attention. You’ll work closely with field operators and internal teams, make quick calls when issues come up, and speak directly with customers when needed. 



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable making quick decisions, switching between different tools, and working with both internal teams and external customers. You’ll be working closely with U.S.-based field teams every shift, so previous experience supporting U.S. operations remotely is a strong plus. Since this function is still being built, you’ll also have a real opportunity to help shape the workflows, escalation paths, and processes that the team will use as it grows.



What You'll Do

- Monitor fleet activity and alert channels across multiple platforms and markets, tracking robot and vehicle locations, battery levels, active tasks, and delivery status.

- Own operational issues through resolution by identifying and prioritizing issues as they arise, including stalled or  immobilized robots, unsafe conditions, missed tasks, and deliveries that fall off schedule.

- Contact the assigned field operator to resolve the issue, and follow established escalation procedures when they do not respond within the required timeframe.

- Coordinate backup coverage when the assigned operator is unavailable so that fleet operations continue without interruption.

- Continuously triage incoming alerts, messages, and fleet data, determining what requires immediate action and what can be handled through normal workflows.

- Prioritize and coordinate field service activity across markets, including battery swaps, robot recoveries, fleet interventions, and other service stops.

- Handle calls from drivers and supervisors on active runs who are unable to locate a delivery address or reach a customer, and resolve the issue on their behalf.

- Contact customers directly to confirm delivery locations, obtain access instructions, or complete a drop off.

- Document each i
, the actions taken, and any details relevant to future operations - such as gate codes, difficult access points, and recurring problem locations - and help pinpoint recurring patterns that can improve future workflows and customer technology.

- Contribute to the development of dispatch procedures, escalation paths, and operational documentation as the operation grows.

- Work across multiple customer platforms, dashboards, Slack channels, and internal tools, quickly building context even when information is spread across different systems.



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in dispatch, logistics, fleet operations, transportation, field operations, or another fast-moving operations environment.

- At least 1 year of experience working directly with a startup is highly preferred

- Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, customers, drivers, operators, or field teams, preferably in a remote or offshore setup.

- Hands-on experience coordinating drivers, field workers, technicians, couriers, vehicles, deliveries, or other moving resources.

- Strong real-time problem-solving skills. You can assess a situation quickly, figure out what needs to happen, and take action without waiting to be told every step.

- Comfortable handling multiple tasks, systems, and communication channels at the same time, as well as piecing together information across multiple tools when troubleshooting an issue.

- Confident in communicating with customers, drivers, operators, and internal teams, including people you may be interacting with for the first time.

- Comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with unfamiliar customers, drivers, and operators in real time.

- Strong, natural English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Strong documentation skills with the ability to clearly capture what happened, what was done, and what needs to happen next.

- Comfortable working with technology and learning unfamiliar platforms quickly.

- Able to stay calm, organized, and responsive when several time-sensitive issues happen at once.

- Comfortable working in a startup environment where processes and tools are still evolving.

- Available to work U.S.-aligned hours, including weekends or other coverage periods when needed.

- Reliable internet connection and a dependable work-from-home setup.



Salary and Benefits:

- Base salary: 55,000 PHP per month

- Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

- 100% Work From Home



Application Instructions

Please send your resume link using a publicly accessible PDF from Google Drive. Make sure it is a direct file link (not a folder or Google Doc).

Links from Dropbox, OneDrive, OnlineJobs, or other similar platforms, as well as non-direct file links, may not be reviewed by our Talent Team.

Please also include:

- A short explanation of why you're a good fit for the role

- Copy and paste this Job ID: recmo8reAKGvUZ3su and include it in your
 subject line

 body: "I'm excited to be applying to Job recmo8reAKGvUZ3su!"



This will help us identify your application quickly and also shows that you’ve read the entire job description (attention to detail is important for this role). Thanks and hope to hear from you soon!

We help small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S. find better, more affordable waste solutions tailored to their needs.

- A reliable desktop or laptop computer meeting modern performance standards.

- A dedicated, quiet professional workspace.

- A high-quality noise-cancelling headset.

- A stable, high-speed internet connection (with a secondary backup preferred).

Phase I: Haulla Sales Training (1 Month)  

- Participation in the Haulla sales agent training program for structured onboarding into Haulla's sales systems, CRM, and internal tools.

Phase II: Sales Agent Probation Period (2 Months)

- Active engagement in the sales cycle as a regular agent to demonstrate performance excellence and mastery of the sales process.

Phase III: Fast-Track Opportunity of an Assistant Team Leader 

- Drive the full sales cycle—from outbound lead generation to deal closing—to achieve and exceed monthly revenue targets.

I do not want to have to remember every follow-up myself.



If someone promises something by Wednesday, you should know that it is due Wednesday and follow up if we do not receive it.



2. Organization & Google Drive



You will help keep our company organized.



This includes:



Organizing Google Drive folders

Making sure files are saved in the correct project folders

Maintaining consistent file names

Making sure we are using the newest version of each file

Organizing tech packs, artwork, purchase orders, invoices, shipping documents, approvals, and product information

Maintaining Google Sheets and trackers

Keeping project records clean and easy to understand

Taking information from
s, messages, spreadsheets, and PDFs and organizing it into one clear place



You should naturally enjoy keeping things organized.



3. Adobe Illustrator & Artwork Support



Because we work heavily with apparel, merchandise, printing, and manufacturing, Adobe Illustrator experience is required.



You do NOT need to be an advanced creative graphic designer.



However, you should be comfortable enough with Illustrator that we do not need to send every small production-related task to a designer.



You should be able to:



Open AI, EPS, PDF, and vector artwork files

Understand the difference between vector and raster artwork

Check artwork dimensions

Resize artwork

Separate designs into individual files

Make simple text changes

Make simple color changes

Check Pantone/color information when provided

Organize artwork by product, color, SKU, or project

Prepare clean artwork files for printers and factories

Export files correctly

Compare artwork against client-approved files

Check whether the correct artwork version is being used

Identify obvious artwork or resolution problems

Make simple placement adjustments

Help organize print-production files



This position is not responsible for creating complicated original artwork from scratch.



Think of this as production artwork support, not full-time graphic design.



4. Invoice & Payment Tracking



You will help me stay organized financially.



Responsibilities include:



Track supplier invoices

Track customer invoices

Match invoices against purchase orders

Verify quantities

Verify agreed pricing

Check invoice totals for obvious mistakes

Track deposits and remaining balances

Maintain records of payments already made

Track payment due dates

Remind me when payments need to be made

Remind me when customer payments need to be collected

Organize receipts and payment confirmations

Help prepare simple cost summaries



You will not be the company accountant and you will not make financial decisions.



However, you must be comfortable working carefully with numbers.



If an invoice says 1,250 units and our purchase order says 1,200 units, I expect you to notice and investigate before we pay it.



5. Executive & Schedule Support



You will also help manage my schedule and priorities.



This may include:



Managing my Google Calendar

Scheduling meetings

Keeping track of important calls

Reminding me of deadlines

Maintaining my daily priority list

Following up on tasks I assign

Helping organize what needs my attention

Separating urgent issues from things that can wait

Making sure important requests do not disappear inside
 or messaging apps



One of the most important parts of this role is helping reduce the number of things I personally need to remember.



6. Communication & Follow-Up



Our company operates between the United States and China.



You will communicate with people in different countries and time zones.



You need to be comfortable:



Following up professionally

Asking clear questions

Getting missing information

Following up more than once when necessary

Communicating through
 and messaging apps

Summarizing complicated information clearly

Escalating problems when necessary



You should not be afraid to say:



“We are still missing this information and we need it by tomorrow in order to stay on schedule.”



Professional persistence is important.



The Person I Am Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Proactive

Reliable

Comfortable managing many projects simultaneously

Good at remembering deadlines

Strong at following up

Comfortable with numbers

Strong with Google Sheets

Comfortable using Adobe Illustrator

Good at written English

Comfortable communicating internationally

Comfortable asking questions when something does not make sense

Able to work independently

Able to learn quickly

Good at identifying inconsistencies

Someone who enjoys creating systems and organization



I especially value someone whose natural thought process is:



“What are we missing?”



and:



“What needs to happen next?”



Rather than simply:



“I finished the task I was assigned.”



Tools We Use



You should already know or be willing to quickly learn:



Google Sheets

Google Drive

Gmail

Google Calendar

Adobe Illustrator


 or similar project-management software

WhatsApp

WeChat

PDFs

Purchase orders

Invoices

Tech packs

ChatGPT / AI tools



Strong Google Sheets skills are highly valued.



Experience That Is Helpful



Experience in any of these areas is a plus:



Project coordination

Project management

Executive assistance

Operations

Supply chain

Manufacturing

Apparel

Fashion

Merchandise

Product development

Printing

Graphic-production support

Procurement

Purchasing

Logistics

E-commerce



You do not need experience in every area.



I care more about your organization, intelligence, attention to detail, ownership, and ability to learn.



Working Hours



This position must have some overlap with both:



China business hours

and

U.S. Pacific Time



Because you would be working from the Philippines, the schedule may require later working hours.



The exact schedule can be discussed with the right candidate.



Please only apply if you are comfortable working a schedule designed around international operations.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is a long-term full-time position.



I am not looking for someone for a temporary project.



My goal is to find someone who can learn our company extremely well and eventually understand:



Our clients

Our products

Our suppliers

Our factories

Our printers

Our warehouses

Our processes

Our deadlines

Our pricing

Our files

Our projects



Over time, I want this person to take ownership of a significant portion of our day-to-day operational coordination.



There will be room to grow as the company grows.



How to Apply



At the very beginning of your application, write:



STARFISH



Applications that do not include this word may not be reviewed.



Please answer all of the following questions:



1.



Tell me about a previous job where you had to manage many projects, deadlines, people, or moving parts at the same time.



2.



Imagine you are responsible for 15 active product-development projects.



Each project has:



Artwork

Samples

Client approvals

Production deadlines

Supplier payments

Shipping dates



How would you organize everything so nothing is forgotten?



3.



A supplier tells you on Monday:



“I will send the sample tomorrow.”



It is now Wednesday and there has been no update.



What would you do?



4.



You receive an invoice showing 1,250 units, but our purchase order says 1,200 units.



What would you do?



5.



Your manager has 20 things happening at the same time and occasionally forgets who he asked to do something.



How would you create a system to prevent things from being forgotten?



6.



Rate your Adobe Illustrator skill from 1–10.



Then explain specifically what you can do in Illustrator.



Please do not simply write “graphic design.”



Tell me whether you are comfortable with things such as:



Vector files

Resizing artwork

Separating artwork

Changing colors

Editing text

Exporting files

Checking dimensions

Preparing production files

7.



What project-management tools have you used?



8.



How would you rate your Google Sheets or Excel skills from 1–10?



Please give examples of what you know how to do.



9.



Are you comfortable working a schedule that overlaps with both China and U.S. Pacific Time?



10.



Please describe your internet connection and your backup plan if your internet or electricity goes down.



Shortlisted Candidates



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small paid test.



The test may include:



Organizing a small project

Identifying missing information

Checking an invoice against another document

Creating a simple project tracker

Performing basic Adobe Illustrator artwork tasks



The purpose of the test is not to see how quickly you work.



It is to see how you think, organize information, notice details, and solve problems.



If you are someone who loves organization, enjoys keeping projects moving, notices details other people miss, and wants to become an important part of a growing company, I would like to hear from you.

title: Pinterest Marketing & Product Research Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I run a small digital products brand selling downloadable planners, trackers, journals, and prompt packs. Products are sold on Gumroad and marketed through Pinterest.



I'm looking for one person to own two things: figuring out what to make, and getting it in front of people. I handle product creation. You handle research and everything after.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Research Pinterest to identify product opportunities with real demand: trending searches, saturation levels, what's actually getting saved and clicked

- Send me clear recommendations on what to build next, with your reasoning

- Create and schedule pins in Tailwind (multiple designs per product, consistent posting)

- Write pin titles and descriptions optimized for Pinterest search

- Monitor performance: impressions, outbound clicks, saves, and sales

- Send a short weekly report on what's working, what isn't, and what you recommend next

- Maintain a rolling list of 5 active products. Underperformers get cycled out, new research cycles in



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



- Proven Pinterest marketing experience, specifically driving traffic to products (not just growing follower counts)

- Comfortable with Tailwind and Canva

- Strong written English

- Self-directed. I need someone who pushes this forward and tells me what to do next rather than waiting on instructions

- Honest about what the data says, even when it's bad news



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience selling on Gumroad or Etsy

- Ability to design pin graphics in Canva

- Experience in the productivity, planner, budgeting, or journaling spaces

- **Design Experience in Canva** This is a role that is currently completed by someone else, so design experience is a plus and an opportunity for additional hours. 



COMPENSATION



Hourly base plus a percentage of gross profit. I want the person who grows this to benefit from growing it.



Starts around 5-10 hours per week. This is intended as a long-term staff role, not a one-off project. If it takes off, it opens into full-time. 



TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A Pinterest account you've grown or managed, with rough numbers (monthly views, outbound clicks)

2. A short description of a product or store you drove traffic to and what the results were

3. Your answer to this question: Given a brand selling printable planners and budget trackers to women aged 25-45, what would be the first thing you'd check on Pinterest to d
 what product to make next, and why?



Applications without an answer to question 3 will not be reviewed.

title: Inventory Analyst & Purchasing Coordinator
description:
Inventory Analyst & Purchasing Coordinator (Remote – Philippines-Based Contractor)

Location: Remote (Philippines) — Independent Contractor

Reports to: Director of Sourcing and Procurement

Schedule: Full-time Contractor is required to work the same hours as the Tucson office — Monday–Friday, [8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time (MST, no DST)] — which corresponds to approximately 11:00 PM–8:00 AM Philippine Time. This overlap is required to support direct collaboration, shadowing, and real-time training with the Tucson team during onboarding.



About the Role

We're looking for a detail-driven Inventory Analyst who can own a complex inventory forecasting and valuation model for a fast-growing e-commerce distribution business, while also supporting our purchasing team with day-to-day PO management. This is a great fit for someone who's equally comfortable building and maintaining advanced Excel models and executing hands-on procurement tasks in an ERP system.



Key Responsibilities

-Inventory Analysis

-Maintain and continuously refine a complex, multi-variable inventory model covering demand forecasting, reorder points, safety stock, and lead-time variability across hundreds of SKUs

-Perform ABC/XYZ segmentation and identify slow-moving, excess, or at-risk inventory

-Reconcile inventory valuation (average cost) between the ERP system and supporting models/reports

-Build and maintain dashboards and reports (Excel/Power BI) tracking inventory turns, fill rate, stockout risk, and carrying cost

-Partner with finance on month-end inventory close and variance analysis

-Flag and investigate discrepancies between system-recorded inventory and physical/warehouse counts

-Purchasing / PO Support

-Create, issue, and track purchase orders in the ERP system based on model-driven replenishment recommendations

-Monitor open PO status, expected delivery dates, and follow up with vendors on delays

-Reconcile PO discrepancies (quantity, pricing, receiving) with the warehouse and accounts payable

-Maintain accurate vendor and item records to support clean PO processing

-Assist with vendor communication regarding lead times, pricing updates, and order confirmations

-Support ad hoc purchasing analysis (vendor performance, cost trends, order pattern reviews)



Qualifications

-3+ years of experience in inventory analysis, demand planning, or supply chain analytics, ideally in distribution, e-commerce, or manufacturing

-Advanced Excel skills required (Power Query, pivot tables, complex formulas, model-building) — this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have

-Hands-on experience with an ERP system for inventory and purchasing (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central strongly preferred; similar ERP experience considered)

-Strong written and spoken English communication skills

-Highly analytical, organized, and comfortable owning a model with many moving parts

-Experience supporting purchase order processes: creation, tracking, receiving reconciliation

-Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field preferred



Nice to Have

-Experience with Shopify or e-commerce order/inventory flows

-Exposure to Power BI for dashboarding

-Familiarity with U.S. import/customs documentation as it relates to inventory receipts



Contract Details

Engagement type: Independent contractor (not an employee) — you're responsible for your own taxes and benefits under Philippine law

title: Property Accountant
description:
Property Accountant



Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Mountain Time, with a 30-minute unpaid break



Salary: $1,400 per month





Job Overview: 



We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Property Accountant to manage the full accounting cycle for a portfolio of condominium corporations, residential rental properties, and commercial properties. The ideal candidate will prepare monthly and year-end financial statements, perform bank reconciliations, maintain general ledger accounts, manage journal entries and accruals, and support financial reporting and audit requirements. Strong knowledge of property accounting, Excel, and financial reporting is required, while experience with Yardi or similar property management accounting software is strongly preferred. The successful candidate should be highly organized, analytical, and accurate, with the ability to manage multiple properties and reporting deadlines while working effectively with Property Managers, Condominium Managers, and the accounting team. 





Key Responsibilities:



Perform full-cycle accounting for an assigned portfolio of condominium corporations, residential rental properties, and commercial properties.



Prepare monthly and year-end financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, budget-to-actual reports, general ledgers, and supporting schedules.



Complete monthly bank reconciliations and investigate and resolve discrepancies.



Enter transactions into Yardi.



Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, prepaid expenses, accruals, intercompany accounts, deposits, and other balance sheet accounts.



Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, adjustments, and year-end entries as required.



Prepare monthly financial reporting packages for Condominium Managers and Boards of Directors.



Review financial results and identify unusual transactions, significant variances, errors, or emerging financial concerns.



Assist with year-end audit and review engagements, reconciliations, schedules, and supporting documentation for external accountants and auditors.



Review property accounting records to ensure transactions are properly coded and allocated to the correct property, account, department, or project.



Assist with accounting requirements related to property transitions, new property onboarding, and management terminations.



Maintain organized electronic accounting records and supporting documentation.



Ensure accounting procedures comply with company policies, internal controls, contractual requirements, and generally accepted accounting practices.



Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls, reporting, and efficiency.



Work collaboratively with Accounts Payable, Property Management, Administration, and senior management.



Manage multiple reporting deadlines and ensure financial statements and other accounting deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.



Perform other accounting and financial duties as required.





Required Skills & Qualifications:



Minimum 3 years of accounting experience, preferably in property management, real estate, condominium management, or a related industry.



Demonstrated experience with full-cycle accounting and preparation of monthly financial statements.



Experience managing accounting for multiple properties, entities, or cost centers is strongly preferred.



Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting, bank reconciliations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, accruals, budgeting, and financial reporting.



Previous experience with Yardi or similar property management accounting software is strongly preferred.



Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including spreadsheets, formulas, reconciliations, and financial schedules.



Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Google Docs.



Accounting diploma, degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.



Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, analytical, and problem-solving skills.



Ability to independently manage a portfolio of properties and multiple reporting deadlines.



Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to identify discrepancies and investigate issues through resolution.



Strong English written and verbal communication skills and a professional, responsive approach when working with Property Managers, Condominium Managers, and senior management.



Strong sense of accountability and ownership over assigned responsibilities.



Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within an accounting and property management team.



High level of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.







Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Social Media & Content Marketing Manager
description:
About the Company



We are a growing Australian commercial services business, initially focused on commercial cleaning and expanding into additional commercial service categories.



We are building a strong, recognisable brand across multiple digital platforms and are looking for a capable Social Media & Content Marketing Manager to take ownership of our organic social media presence.



This is not a basic posting or Canva VA position.



We want someone who can develop ideas, create content, edit videos, use AI intelligently, understand what performs on each platform and consistently grow our online presence.



Your Main Objective



Build our business into a highly visible and credible brand within the Australian commercial services market through consistent, high-quality content.



You will be responsible for taking ideas, business information, industry topics and occasional real-world footage and turning them into content people actually want to watch, read and share.



A significant amount of content will need to be created using AI tools.



However:

LinkedIn

TikTok

YouTube

YouTube Shorts

Spotify / podcast platforms

 Groups

mber.

Repurposing

Content variations

Long-Form Content & Podcast

Interviews

Business discussions

Industry commentary

Educational videos

Podcast episodes



You will assist with editing, packaging and distribution.



A single podcast episode, interview or long-form video should be turned into multiple pieces of content across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



We want to extract maximum value from everything we create.



 Group Creation & Management



Create and grow an industry-related 
munity connected to the markets we operate within.



You will:



Help develop the group's positioning

Grow group membership

Create regular discussion posts

Publish useful industry content

Encourage member participation

Moderate posts and comments

Remove spam

Identify useful discussion topics

title: Part-Time Search Operations Coordinator - Private Investment Firm
description:
Glass Bay Capital is a U.S.-based investment firm searching for one exceptional business to acquire and operate for the long term.



We are hiring a highly detail-oriented, Philippines-based Search Operations Coordinator to help operate the systems behind our proprietary and brokered deal sourcing efforts.



This is not a generic virtual assistant role, cold-calling role, or list-building job.



We use a sophisticated technology stack involving HubSpot, 
, AI-powered research workflows, enrichment tools,
 verification tools, and structured sourcing processes. Your role will be to make sure approved data moves cleanly through those systems, errors are caught, records remain accurate, and campaigns are assembled correctly.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



Approximately 10 hours per week to start. $8 USD/hour. 30-day paid trial initially, with the expectation of a long-term relationship if the fit is strong.



Hours can generally be completed asynchronously. Some availability during U.S. Central Time will occasionally be helpful for training and check-ins.



The role may expand over time, but we strongly value automation and process improvement. We do not want someone doing manually what software can reliably handle.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



HubSpot CRM Operations

- Execute approved CRM imports using established templates and procedures.

- Review imports for errors, duplicates, incorrect associations, missing fields, and formatting issues.

- Maintain clean company and contact records.

- Resolve routine CRM data-quality exceptions.

- Document import batches and corrections.

- Escalate ambiguous cases instead of guessing.



Outreach Operations

- Prepare approved contacts for outreach campaigns in 
.

- Assemble high-touch campaigns using personalization and research already prepared by our team and AI workflows.

- Verify that the correct company, person,
 address, personalization, campaign, mailbox, and CRM status are being used.

- Confirm suppression and exclusion rules before campaigns are activated.

- Identify and resolve routine synchronization, bounce, and campaign-data problems.

- Initially, campaigns will be staged for review rather than sent autonomously.



Data Quality & Research Operations

- Verify business mailing addresses for owners, brokers, industry experts, and other contacts.

- Record the address, source, address type, confidence level, date verified, and any ambiguity.

- Review outputs from enrichment and verification tools for obvious errors.

- Investigate data discrepancies when automated tools disagree.

- Maintain structured records of exceptions and corrections.



Process Improvement

- Identify repetitive manual tasks that could potentially be automated.

- Maintain an Automation Candidate Log describing recurring problems or manual fixes.

- Follow written SOPs closely while suggesting improvements when appropriate.



The goal is not to create more manual work. The goal is to operate the human checkpoints that remain necessary after automation.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



You will not make investment decisions. You will not evaluate whether a company is a good acquisition. You will not d
 which businesses receive high-touch outreach. You will not conduct seller calls or broker calls. You will not write investment analyses or evaluate CIMs. You will not control banking, payroll, investor information, or legal documents. You will not independently change CRM architecture, outreach strategy, property definitions, or automation rules. You will not send sensitive or highly personalized outreach without appropriate approval.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are unusually careful with details. You notice when two records that look similar are actually different companies. You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, structured data, CRMs, and web-based software. You understand that an ambiguous answer should sometimes be escalated rather than "solved." You can follow a written process exactly. You document what you changed. You are comfortable learning new software. You communicate clearly in written English. You are interested in using AI and automation to improve your work rather than viewing automation as a threat.



Experience with HubSpot, 
, Salesforce, Apollo, other CRMs, outbound
 platforms, or data-enrichment tools is helpful but not required. Precision and judgment are more important than having used every tool before.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE ANSWER ALL SIX QUESTIONS



Your application must answer all six questions below. Applications that skip questions will not advance.



1. Describe a situation where you found an error in a spreadsheet, CRM, database, or operational process that someone else missed. What did you do?



2. Imagine you are importing 500 contacts into a CRM. Ten records appear to be duplicates, fifteen are missing important information, and three contain information that conflicts with another source. Describe how you would handle the batch.



3. If a written procedure tells you to use one value but online research suggests another value might be correct, what would you do?



4. What CRM, spreadsheet,
 outreach, enrichment, or data-management tools have you used?



5. Tell us about one repetitive task you have automated or made significantly more efficient.



6. What is your current weekly availability?



Candidates who advance will be invited to complete a short paid work sample using fictional company and contact data.

 marketing, SEO, website content, podcast marketing, CRM platforms, or marketing automation is a plus.

title: Operations Manager / Finance & Admin Coordinator
description:
Operations Manager / Finance & Admin Coordinator



Synergy Wetsuits

Remote / Philippines-Based Independent Contractor



Summary

Location: Remote / Philippines-based

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Experience: 5+ years operations, finance admin, vendor management, accounting support, or business administration

Commitment: 30 hours/week to start, with the possibility of increasing to 40 hours/week as business needs grow

Schedule: Monday to Friday, starting at 7:00 AM Pacific Time

Initial Hours: 7:00 AM–1:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday to Friday

Compensation: $12–$16/hour USD, depending on experience and qualifications

Bonus: Eligible for a discretionary annual contractor bonus after 12 months of continuous service, based on performance and company needs

Start Date: Immediate or as soon as possible



Synergy Wetsuits is a triathlon wetsuit, apparel, and accessories company based in Minden, Nevada, USA. We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager / Finance & Admin Coordinator to help keep our operations, finance admin, vendor agreements, compliance deadlines, and business records organized.



This role is for someone who can manage details without constant reminders. You should be comfortable working with invoices, payment schedules, vendor records, contracts, tax deadlines, compliance requirements, and monthly bookkeeping close support.



We need someone who can spot the missing invoice, expiring agreement, unfinished close item, or upcoming deadline before it becomes a fire drill.



About Synergy Wetsuits



Synergy Wetsuits designs and sells triathlon wetsuits, swim gear, apparel, and accessories for athletes around the world. We work with customers, retailers, events, vendors, factories, fulfillment teams, logistics partners, and business partners across the US, UK, Europe, and other markets.



We are a small, busy team, so this role requires someone organized, dependable, proactive, and comfortable working across departments.



Responsibilities



Operations Management

• Help manage daily business operations and admin workflows

• Track tasks, deadlines, deliverables, and open items across departments

• Coordinate with warehouse, fulfillment, logistics, product development, customer service, sales, marketing, and finance

• Follow up with vendors, suppliers, contractors, and tea
mbers

• Organize company documents, SOPs, trackers, reports, and shared folders

• Help improve processes and keep business records clean, current, and easy to access

• Support onboarding and admin setup for new tea
mbers

• Keep leadership aware of unresolved issues, upcoming deadlines, and operational gaps



Finance Admin & Monthly Bookkeeping Close

• Manage invoice approvals, payment schedules, and accounts payable follow-up

• Track bills, due dates, recurring charges, subscriptions, vendor fees, and service agreements

• Follow up on missing invoices, receipts, statements, vendor bills, and backup documents

• Coordinate monthly bookkeeping close with the bookkeeper

• Make sure invoices, payments, reconciliations, missing documents, and month-end reports are completed accurately and on time

• Organize financial records, bank statements, invoices, receipts, contracts, and supporting documents

• Work with the bookkeeper, accountant, tax preparer, and leadership team as needed

• Prepare reports, summaries, checklists, and trackers for leadership review



Vendor Agreements & Compliance

• Organize vendor agreements, contracts, pricing sheets, account documents, and renewal terms

• Track renewal dates, pricing terms, annual reviews, expiration dates, and contract deadlines

• Manage vendor records for FedEx, UPS, DHL, freight forwarders, 3PL partners, and other logistics vendors

• Make sure vendor contracts are reviewed at least annually

• Flag pricing changes, expiring agreements, outdated terms, and missing documents

• Maintain a tax and compliance filing calendar

• Track sales tax, VAT, business taxes, 1099s, annual reports, registrations, licenses, insurance documents, resale certificates, W-9s, and vendor forms

• Help make sure filings and renewals are completed regularly and on time



Executive Support for CEO

• Provide light business and personal admin support to the CEO

• Schedule meetings, calls, appointments, and travel when needed

• Track follow-ups, reminders, deadlines, and action items

• Organize key documents, contracts, records, and shared files

• Draft simple
s, updates, and internal messages

• Help with occasional remote personal admin tasks

• Handle confidential business, finance, and personal information with discretion



Must-Haves

• 5+ years of experience in operations management, finance admin, accounting support, vendor management, or business administration

• Experience working with US-based companies

• Strong understanding of bookkeeping workflows, accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and payment tracking

• Experience coordinating monthly bookkeeping close with a bookkeeper, accountant, or finance team

• Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting software

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills

• Ecommerce operations experience

• Experience with Shopify and Amazon Seller Central

• Experience with shipping carriers or logistics vendors such as FedEx, UPS, DHL, freight forwarders, or 3PL partners

• Experience organizing vendor agreements, service contracts, renewals, financial documents, and business records

• Experience with sales tax, VAT, 1099s, annual reports, registrations, or compliance tracking

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• Excellent attention to detail

• Highly organized, dependable, proactive, and trustworthy

• Available Monday to Friday starting at 7:00 AM Pacific Time

• Open to starting at 30 hours/week and increasing to 40 hours/week if business needs grow

• Reliable internet connection and computer setup



Nice-to-Haves

• Experience in apparel, sporting goods, logistics, ecommerce, or consumer products

• Experience with PayPal, Stripe, Airwallex, Wise, or other payment platforms

• Experience with Asana, Trello, Monday, ClickUp, or similar tools

• Experience creating SOPs, trackers, templates, or process documentation

• Interest in sports, triathlon, swimming, or fitness



Independent Contractor Terms



This is an independent contractor opportunity. The selected contractor will be engaged under a written contractor agreement and will submit invoices for services.

The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, government registrations, insurance, benefits, equipment, and compliance requirements in their country of residence.

The annual contractor bonus is discretionary and is not an employee benefit, statutory 13th-month pay, or guaranteed compensation.



Who We’re Looking For



We want someone who can become part of our core operations team — not just someone who waits for tasks.

The right person can think ahead, follow up without being reminded, catch problems early, protect confidential information, and turn messy details into clean systems.

This role is a good fit if you are organized, detail-oriented, calm under pressure, confident asking questions, and comfortable working with leadership, bookkeepers, accountants, vendors, logistics partners, and internal teams.



Who This Role Is Not For



This may not be the right fit if:



• You need constant step-by-step supervision

• You avoid follow-ups

• You are not comfortable working with financial or confidential information

• You prefer repetitive admin work only

• You are looking for a pure bookkeeping role

• You are looking for a pure executive assistant role

• You are not available to start at 7:00 AM Pacific Time



To Apply



 the following to 
 with the subject line:



Operations Manager / Finance Admin Applicant – [Your Name]



Please include:

1. Responses to the questions below

2. Resume and cover letter

3. Short video introducing yourself, explaining why you are interested in this role, and why you think you would be a strong fit for Synergy Wetsuits



Applicant Questions

1. Are you available Monday to Friday starting at 7:00 AM Pacific Time, beginning at 30 hours/week with the possibility of increasing to 40 hours/week?

2. Are you comfortable working as an independent contractor and submitting invoices for your services?

3. What hourly rate are you applying for within the posted $12–$16/hour USD range?

4. How many years of experience do you have in operations management, finance admin, vendor management, accounting support, or business administration?

5. What accounting, ecommerce, and operations tools have you used? Please include QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Excel/Google Sheets, and any project management tools.

6. Describe your experience coordinating monthly bookkeeping close, invoice/payment tracking, accounts payable, reconciliations, or missing financial documents.

7. Describe your experience managing vendor agreements, service contracts, renewals, logistics vendors, tax/compliance deadlines, or business records.

8. Tell us about a time you created order out of a messy process, system, tracker, or filing issue. What did you fix, and what was the result?

title: Senior Media Buyer - Meta Ads
description:
About Us

Guaranteed Estimates is a growth partner for US roofing contractors. We don't sell cheap, shared leads; we deliver exclusive, pre-booked appointments that turn into real revenue for our clients.



The roofing industry is tough, direct, and full of skeptical contractors who have been burned by bad marketing agencies. They value no-nonsense results, clear communication, and partners they can actually trust. Our backend media buying and systems are dialed in—we just need a strong commercial operator to own the client side.



The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads Specialist) to become the primary engine of our lead generation. This role is 90% hands-on campaign execution and 10% mentorship, making it perfect for someone who loves being deep in the weeds of Meta Ads but also enjoys leveling up junior tea
mbers.



You’ll manage significant ad budgets, optimize campaigns at scale, and directly impact our bottom line on a daily basis. At the same time, you’ll set the standard for best practices across the team, ensuring both performance and knowledge transfer.



What You’ll Do

Campaign Management (85%): Manage, optimize, and scale complex Meta Ads campaigns with precision.



Testing & Innovation (20% of budget, ~15% of time): Design and run structured tests on new creatives, audiences, and landing pages to fuel ongoing growth.



Mentorship: Provide guidance and oversight to Junior Media Buyers, helping them develop technical skills, judgment, and confidence.



Analysis & Insights: Track and report on key metrics (CPL, CPA, ROAS), translating performance into actionable insights for leadership.



Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales and Customer Success leaders to ensure campaign objectives align with lead quality and client success.



What You’ll Bring

Experience: 3–5+ years of deep, hands-on Meta Ads management 
/Instagram).



Scale: Proven success managing $50,000–$100,000+ monthly budgets.



Results: A strong record of hitting CPL and CPA targets with consistent performance.



Analytical Skills: Data-driven mindset with a structured approach to testing and optimization.



Autonomy: Ability to self-manage priorities, workflows, and ambitious performance targets.



Leadership: A genuine desire to mentor Junior Media Buyers and contribute to a culture of excellence.



How Success is Measured

Performance: Campaigns consistently achieve or outperform CPL and CPA targets.



Innovation: A structured testing framework that produces measurable improvements in creative, targeting, and landing page performance.



Team Impact: Positive feedback and visible skill growth from Junior Media Buyers under your mentorship.



How we operate (our Core Values)

We don't just put these on a slide deck and forget about them. These are the four non-negotiable standards we expect everyone on our team to live by:



Trust, But Verify: We validate everything. We don't assume a partner is happy just because they haven't complained, and we don't guess when it comes to campaign data. We look at the facts, research the details, and document the truth.



Help First: No task is beneath us. We are a lean, fast-moving team, and we serve each other and our partners. If a teammate needs a hand or a partner is struggling to close an appointment, we step up to help—period.



Direct with Respect: We practice high EQ and give honest, constructive feedback without being defensive. We don't do passive-aggressive corporate speak. We address issues head-on, but always with mutual respect and professionalism.



Own the Outcome: No excuses, no finger-pointing. We take extreme accountability for our metrics, our relationships, and our mistakes. If something isn't working, we own the fix and deliver the results.



WHERE TO APPLY:

Click the link below and fill out our application:

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR

Synergy Wetsuits

Remote Independent Contractor Role

Synergy Wetsuits is a triathlon wetsuit, apparel, and accessories company based in Minden, Nevada, USA. We are looking for an experienced Product Development Coordinator to support our product development team with research, sampling, costing packages, trim details, sourcing, vendor communication, logistics coordination, and production follow-up.



This is a remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor will work with the Synergy team on product development tasks, production timelines, vendor follow-ups, sample tracking, and shipment coordination. The right person is organized, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces without constant supervision.



At Synergy Wetsuits, we move fast, solve problems, and care deeply about creating great products for triathletes and swimmers. We are looking for someone proactive, reliable, flexible, and comfortable jumping in where needed. Every day is a little different, which keeps things interesting.

The Product Development Coordinator will support the product development process from concept, design, sampling, production, and release. This role will help track product development timelines, communicate with overseas vendors, follow up on samples and revisions, organize product details, and coordinate information between internal teams and external partners.



The contractor will collaborate closely with the product development team and management to understand the creative direction of each product and help move projects forward. This includes supporting seasonal product calendars, vendor communication, sample tracking, shipment coordination, costing updates, and product documentation.

• Ability to communicate professionally with vendors, tea
mbers, and management

• Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Photoshop or Illustrator

• Experience in triathlon, swimming, sporting goods, apparel, or performance products

• Personal interest in triathlon, swimming, endurance sports, or fitness



SCOPE OF SERVICES:

• Conduct viability research for concept products

Synergy Wetsuits was founded in the early 1990s by Stefan Laursen. The brand was built around creating high-quality triathlon wetsuits, apparel, and accessories at a strong value, while staying connected to the sport and the athletes we serve.



Synergy is a tight-knit, high-performance multisport brand. We are looking for people who care about doing great work, improving processes, collaborating with the team, and helping us build one of the top triathlon brands in the world.

That includes service pages, location pages, landing pages, case studies, blogs, and conversion-focused website copy.

description:

Our podcast explores the inner life of parenthood through warm, candid conversations. It is real talk, rather than another list of parenting hacks.

Podcast Editing

Remove dead air, false starts, distractions, and unnecessary repetition 

Smooth transitions and maintain a natural conversational flow

Level and clean audio, then add intro music, outro music, and light sound design

Create episode show notes, descriptions and timestamps

Prep episodes for distribution across podcast platforms

Turn podcast episodes into short-form clips for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Add captions, basic motion graphics, and platform-appropriate formatting

Create simple branded graphics and social posts using our Canva templates

Help draft captions and copy in our brand voice (warm, honest, a little cheeky, never preachy)



General VA Support:

Keep project-management tools updated and current 

Light research and admin tasks as needed

Help create a consistent, dependable workflow for each episode

Experience editing podcasts, audio, or video content

A portfolio or samples that demonstrate strong editing judgment

Strong written English and a good ear for pacing, tone, and voice

Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate clearly

Careful attention to detail and comfort following an established workflow

Experience creating short-form video content for social platforms



Tools:

You should be comfortable with several of the following:

Riverside

Descript

Adobe Audition or Premiere Pro

CapCut

Canva

Google Workspace

Squarespace

Flodesk

AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT

Experience with every platform is not required. We value strong editing skills, reliability, and the ability to learn new tools.



Helpful Experience:

Experience with parenting, motherhood, wellness, family-lifestyle, or creator-led brands is a plus. Familiarity with conversational, interview-based, or parenting podcasts would be especially helpful.



Role Details:

title: Architect/Residential Designer
description:
THIS IS A REPOST OF A RECENT JOB OPENING.  PLEASE READ IT ALL THE WAY THROUGH.



I have found quite a few talented draftsman.  A couple in fact that are excellent at topo and drawing what I give them.  They are very good at drawing on CAD and even doing renderings.  But not as a good as true architects/designers coming with design ideas and fully understanding how US residential construction works.  Putting it bluntly I don't need someone who did graphic design or store merchandise design and now wants to try to do residential design.  I don't need someone that did examples for school and now wants to be a designer.  I don't need someone who is very proud of their Completion Certificates or profile picture or how they do a portfolio in Canva of fancy projects they probably never touched.
