title: Full-Time Content Operations Manager for Melbourne-Based Digital Marketing Agency
description:
Position Overview

We’re a growing Melbourne-based SEO agency hiring a full-time Content Operations Manager to own our SEO content production pipeline end-to-end — from keyword assignment ? brief creation ? writer management ? QA ? publishing coordination ? indexation + post-publish checks.



This is NOT a writing role. You may occasionally rewrite lines during QA, but your core job is operations: make sure content ships, ships correctly, and ships on time across multiple clients.



You will manage copywriters and VAs, coordinate with developers/publishers, run structured QA, handle client approvals, and keep production dashboards accurate.



What You’ll Own (Responsibilities)



A) Briefs + Production Management

-Build SEO content briefs from assigned keywords (service pages + supporting content) using a consistent template.

-Assign work to copywriters, manage deadlines, and unblock writers fast.

-Maintain a visible production pipeline (status, owner, due dates, blockers).



B) QA (Editorial + SEO + Retrieval-Friendly Formatting)

-Coordinate VA first-pass QA, then complete a strict final QA before anything ships.

-Enforce on-page fundamentals: title tag, H1, meta description, internal linking, headings, intent match.

-Enforce AI-friendly formatting (direct answer blocks, scannable sections, tables where relevant)



C) Publishing Coordination + “Definition of Done”

-Brief developers/publishers with clear requirements (URL, metadata, internal links, schema, layout notes).

-Validate pages before go
 formatting, links, layout, mobile UX, canonical correctness.

-Indexation workflow: submit for indexing and monitor in Google Search Console (and flag issues fast).

-“Done” means: published + accessible + internal links added + schema validated + indexing requested + tracked.



D) Structured Data (Schema)

-Specify and QA schema requirements (Service / LocalBusiness / Article / FAQ) and validate it.

-You do not need to be a developer, but you must confidently manage schema tasks



E) Client Approvals + Revisions

-Manage client approval rounds clearly (what changed, what needs review, deadlines).

-Consolidate feedback, route revision requests, and prevent endless cycles with strong briefs + guardrails.



Tools / Stack (What we use)

-PM: Asana (or similar)

-Docs: Google Drive

-CMS: WordPress

-SEO/content tools: Surfer (or equivalent), GSC, Grammarly

-AI-assisted workflows: ChatGPT / Claude

-Originality checks: Originality.ai (experience preferred)



If you haven’t used one tool but can demonstrate mastery of the workflow, we still want to talk.



What Success Looks Like (90-Day Outcomes)

-You can run 11 clients concurrently without losing track of deadlines or quality.

-Content is shipped with consistent QA, minimal rewrites, and clean approval cycles.

-Publishing handoffs are clear; dev/publisher questions go down.

-Pages are consistently indexed and tracked; issues are flagged early.



Must-Haves

-Strong written/spoken English (non-negotiable).

-Proven experience running content production in an agency setting (multi-client).

-Extremely high attention to detail (daily QA).

-Strong on-page SEO fundamentals and internal linking judgement.

-Comfortable coordinating multiple roles (writers, VA, dev/publisher, account manager).



Nice-to-Haves

-Schema implementation/QA experience.

-Experience building briefs that enforce direct answers + extractable formatting (AI retrieval readiness).

-Familiarity with Surfer SEO for brief building and content scoring



How to Apply

Please start your application with the phrase "BLUE MANAGER" — applications without this will not be considered.



Then complete our screening form: [
]



We will only consider candidates who submit the form.



Selected candidates will complete a short paid test exercise before any hire decision is made.



What We Offer

-$10 USD per hour — full-time 40 hours per week

-Paid on time every time — fortnightly or monthly your choice

-Performance review at 60–90 days — raise to $12/hr based on QA accuracy and pipeline throughput

-Access to a world-class SEO system and SOP library — you'll work inside one of the most structured content production environments available, with step-by-step processes for every stage of the pipeline. This isn't a "figure it out yourself" agency

-Real growth path — as you master the content ops role there is a clear path into broader SEO responsibilities for the right person

-Direct communication with the agency owner

-All tools and access provided from day one

-Long-term stable role with a fast-growing Melbourne agency



Working Hours

-Full-time: 40 hours per week

-Flexible schedule (we can discuss your preferred hours)

-Must have some overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST)



Our Hiring Process

-Application review — form + code word + QA checklist

-5-minute intro call — personal fit

-15-minute technical interview — pipeline and operations knowledge

-Paid test exercise — real work, scoped to 60–90 minutes

-Offer to the right candidate



Important Notes

-We provide full SOP documentation, tools, and training

-Looking to hire immediately for the right person



If you're process-driven, detail-obsessed, and thrive in a fast-moving agency environment — we want to hear from you.

title: Marketing Project manager - Content & client project manager
description:

*MUST READ IN FULL TO APPLY*



Part-time contractor | Remote | Set hourly rate



*MUST READ IN FULL TO APPLY*



About us



Venture to Bloom is a content studio based in Maryland, USA. We run pop-up content creation days for entrepreneurs and small business owners in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area, and we work with consultants, coaches, and business teams to produce video and photo content that drives revenue. We're growing our client roster and need someone to keep our production and delivery process running smoothly behind the scenes.




 




 



The role



You'll be the person making sure nothing falls through the cracks between "footage shot" and "client thrilled with their finished videos." That means staying close to our editing team day to day, reviewing every video before a client sees it, keeping our deliverables tracker current, and stepping in to talk clients through their content when questions come up. You'll also help keep our calendar of client calls and check-ins organized.



As our content project manager, you're the quality gate. If a caption has a typo or a video doesn't match the brief, it should not reach the client, because you caught it first.



What you'll be doing



Video content oversight (this is the core of the role):



Communicating daily with our editing team to keep every project moving on schedule. 

Reviewing each edited video against the original video brief before it goes to the client, checking that story, structure, footage selection, and captions all match what was actually requested. 

Proofreading every caption and on-screen text line carefully; typos do not go out the door. 

Leaving clear, timestamped comments in

Tracking every deliverable in our tracker spreadsheet as it moves through review, revision, and final approval, so nothing gets lost or forgotten (We use Claude AI to create and keep up).

Giving clients a heads-up if a timeline is shifting, before they have to ask.

Setting up client kickoff calls, prep calls, and other meetings. 

Sending reminders and confirming attendance ahead of scheduled calls. 

Keeping our internal calendar and client timelines organized and current.



Process and team communication:



Following our documented process for video review, client delivery, and revision handling. 

Communicating with the team daily via WhatsApp and Slack. 

Flagging anything off track early, a stuck deliverable, a client asking for more than their package includes, a deadline at risk. We'd rather hear about it on day 1 than day 10.

Experience managing a content, video, or creative production workflow (studio, agency, or freelance team environment)

This is steady, ongoing work. We build two to four new reels a month through her club and high school seasons, plus updates to existing ones.



The workflow, exactly as it runs:



Her full game recordings live in Google Drive. You'll have access to the folder.

She watches her own film and sends you a timestamp list: which game file, when the play happens, her cap color and cap number, and what the play is.

You do everything else. Pull each play out of the full game footage, trim it so the highlight reads clearly, add a player identifier at the start of each clip, organize the clips into skill categories, add a title card and section titles, and export.

You send me the finished file. We handle the upload.



What you need to be able to do:



Read a timestamp and find the actual play. This is the most important skill in the job. A timestamp is a marker, not an exact in-point. If the list says 1:42, the play may really begin at 1:38 with the swim and the setup, and the shot lands at 1:44. Your job is to watch around that mark, understand what the play is, and cut so the whole highlight reads: enough lead-in for a coach to see the positioning and the decision, and enough after the finish that nothing gets clipped off. 

Create a player identifier at the start of each play. A circle or an arrow marking my daughter, so a coach knows instantly which player to watch. It only needs to appear at the start of the clip, not follow her. What matters is that it's on the right player and that it looks the same, same shape, same color, same size, on every clip in the reel.

Organize clips into skill categories. The reel isn't one long list. Clips get grouped into sections like goals, assists, steals, ejections drawn, and defensive stops, with a short title card between groups so a coach can see what they're about to watch. I'll tell you the categories for each reel.

Follow a written spec. I'll give you recruiting-specific guidelines on what college coaches actually want to see rather than fluff. In practice that means no music, no transitions, and no effects.

Turn a reel around in 2 to 3 days once you have the footage and the timestamp list.

Handle large video files. You'll be downloading full game recordings, so you need internet that can manage that and a computer that can edit HD footage without struggling.



Software: DaVinci, Premiere, Final Cut, CapCut, or anything else is fine if you can do everything above in it.



Nice to have, not required: you know water polo, or other team sport. Finding the right cap in the water goes faster if you understand what's happening. Say so if you do.



HOW TO APPLY:



1. Start your message with the word COUNTERATTACK in all caps on the first line. I want to know you read the whole post.



2. Send links of two edits you've done. Sports footage is ideal, but any project where you pulled clips out of longer footage and assembled them works. Tell me which parts were yours.



3. Answer in a sentence or two each:



What editing software do you use?

What is your download speed, and can your computer handle editing HD video without slowing down?

Have you worked with sports footage before? Which sport?

Have you ever made highlight reels for college recruits?



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. Thank you!

title: Collections Agent - Collections Caller - Debt Recovery
description:
SEND A VOICE RECORDING WITH YOUR APPLICATION TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE



About the Role



North Funding is a Canadian direct lender providing merchant cash advances to small and medium sized businesses across North America. We are looking for a professional and composed collections caller to join our team on a part time remote basis.



Your role is simple. Every business day you receive a list of merchants with missed or delinquent payments. You call them, you listen, you work with them to find a resolution, and you log everything accurately. You are not aggressive. You are not threatening. You are a professional who helps business owners get back on track while protecting the interests of the company.



What You Will Do



Receive the daily delinquent account report from our operations coordinator every morning by 9am Eastern time. The report includes merchant name, phone number, deal ID, outstanding balance, number of missed payments, and last contact date.

Call every merchant on the daily list. Attempt each merchant at least twice per day at different times if there is no answer on the first attempt. Leave a brief professional voi
 on the first attempt if the merchant does not pick up.

Work through the conversation calmly and professionally. Identify the reason for the missed payment, offer appropriate resolution options within your defined authority, and agree on a clear next step with the merchant before ending the call.

Log every call attempt in our CRM immediately after each call. Record whether the merchant was reached, what was discussed, and what outcome was agreed. Accurate and complete logging is a non negotiable requirement of this role.

Send our operations coordinator a daily end of day summary covering every account you called, the outcome of each call, and any payment arrangements that were agreed.

Flag the operations coordinator immediately if a merchant is unresponsive after multiple attempts, aggressive or threatening, or refusing all cooperation. You never escalate directly to management. All escalations go through the operations coordinator.



Payment Arrangement Authority



You have full authority to offer the following arrangements without any approval needed.

Reduced payment arrangement. You may offer to accept 50% of the merchant's daily payment amount for up to 10 consecutive business days while they stabilize their cash flow. Log the agreed start date and end date in the CRM immediately.

Short payment holiday. You may offer to pause payments entirely for up to 5 consecutive business days. This option can only be offered once per merchant per 6 month period. Log the agreed pause dates in the CRM immediately.

Any arrangement outside these parameters must be escalated to the operations coordinator. You never promise anything you do not have authority to deliver.



What You Never Do



Discuss legal action, court proceedings, or collections agencies with any merchant under any circumstances. Make promises about credit reporting or removing negative marks from any record. Accept payment by any method other than the merchant's existing pre-authorized debit arrangement or a direct wire to our company bank account. Contact merchants outside of Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm Eastern time. Argue, raise your voice, or engage with an aggressive merchant beyond one calm attempt to de-escalate.



What We Are Looking For



Based in the Philippines with reliable internet connection and availability during Eastern business hours. Strong conversational English with clear pronunciation. Calm, professional, and composed when dealing with stressed or difficult business owners. Previous experience in collections, debt recovery, customer service, or financial services outbound calling is required. Comfortable learning and using a CRM system for call logging. Detail oriented with strong written communication for daily reporting. Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

title: Project Manager reviewing and approving AD edits
description:
We produce a lot of ad creative, and every edit our editors make needs a final review before it goes to the client. That's what this role is. You're the last person to check the work, the one who catches the typo, the cut that runs too long, the logo that's slightly off, or the export that doesn't match the brief.



You'll have real authority in this role. If an edit isn't good enough, you can send it back and hold it until it's fixed. We need someone we can trust to make that call and stand behind it.



What you'll do

Review every edit before it goes to the client, check for typos, brand consistency, spec accuracy, and overall quality.

Give the final sign-off. Nothing ships without your approval.

Set a clear standard for what "ready" looks like and hold editors to it.

Give editors specific, useful feedback so the same mistakes don't keep happening.

Track every project in the pipeline so nothing gets missed or stuck.

Stay on top of deadlines and flag early if something's at risk of slipping.

Work closely with editors and the rest of the team to keep everyone aligned.

Who we're looking for



Someone with an exceptional eye for detail. You catch the small things other people miss, and you can't let a mistake slide. This is the most important part of the job, everything else comes second to it.



Someone who can hold their ground. You're comfortable telling a good editor their work isn't ready yet, and you back your judgment. People respect your calls because you're fair and consistent.



Someone who's reliable with deadlines, every time. When you say something will be done by a certain time, it's done. This matters as much as anything else here.



Someone organized. You can keep multiple projects moving at once and always know where each one stands.



Someone who communicates clearly. You give direct, useful feedback and keep people informed without being chased for updates.



Nice to have

Experience in advertising, video, or creative production.

Familiarity with the tools our editors use (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop) so you can spot technical issues.

A background in QA or a similar review role.

The bottom line



Whatever leaves this team, you're the one who d
 it's ready. If you can't stand letting something ship with a mistake in it, and you're never late, this role is for you.



If this sounds like a position that fits you send in a loom explaining why. If you don't send in a loom explaining why you're a good fit for the role your application will be disregarded.

title: Social Media Graphic Designer
description:
The role in one line



You own our Instagram. Every day there's a post, and you designed it, wrote it, and scheduled it.



What you'll actually do

Design and publish one Instagram post per day — carousels, single graphics, and occasional Reels covers. You handle design, copywriting, scheduling, and posting.

Edit short-form video — we'll shoot raw footage (talking head, screen recordings, walkthroughs). You cut it into Reels/TikToks: pacing, captions, b-roll, sound design, hooks in the first 1.5 seconds.

Write the copy — hooks, slide copy, and captions. You're not just laying out text someone hands you; you're d
 what the post says.

Meet with me weekly — 30–45 minutes to review what performed, plan the next week's content, and unblock anything.

Keep a content bank — no scrambling at 11pm. We work a week ahead.

The aesthetic



We want the look of accounts 
 — reference post.



What that means specifically:



Oversized display typography as the main visual event — type is the design

High-contrast, cinematic imagery; heavy compositing when it earns its place

Confident, minimal color systems (one accent color, used with discipline)

Editorial layout logic — real grids, real hierarchy, generous negative space

Concept-first thinking — every post should carry one idea, and the design should argue it visually rather than illustrate it decoratively

Never: templated Canva decks, stock-photo gradients, emoji-heavy slides, clip-art icons



If you look at that reference and think "I know exactly how that was built," we should talk. If you look at it and think "I could do something similar in Canva," we're not a fit.



What you need

A portfolio of Instagram carousels and short-form video edits — actual posted work, not mockups

Fluent in Figma or Adobe (Photoshop/Illustrator/InDesign), plus a video editor (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci — your call, as long as the output is clean)

Strong written English. You're writing the copy, so this is non-negotiable.

Type skills specifically: kerning, hierarchy, knowing when a headline needs to be 4 words instead of 11

Reliable overlap with US Eastern time for the weekly call

Self-directed. I'll give you direction and a brief; I won't art-direct every slide.



Nice to have: motion design (After Effects), familiarity with ecommerce/DTC marketing, experience with a scheduling tool (Later, Metricool, Buffer).



Rate and growth



This starts at $3/hr and goes up to $8/hr — that's not a vague someday, it's the actual ceiling for this role and I'd rather pay it than keep re-hiring.



What moves you up the range:



Agency. You spot that a post underperformed and bring a fix to the weekly call before I ask. You unblock yourself instead of waiting on me.

Fewer revision rounds. Round-one work that ships is worth multiples of work that needs three passes.

Copy that lands. When your hooks outperform mine, you're doing the expensive part of the job.

Throughput. Consistently a week ahead, no gaps in the calendar.

Results. Saves, shares, profile visits, and inbound trending up.



Realistically that's a review at 30 days and 90 days, with the top of the range reserved for someone I can hand a topic to and get a finished post back.



Application assignment



I only consider applicants who complete this. It's how I evaluate real skill instead of a portfolio that may or may not be yours.



The brief: Design a carousel titled "The Way of the Wolf" — the sales techniques from Jordan Belfort's book, connected back to the scenes everyone remembers from The Wolf of Wall Street, and translated into something a marketer can use.



The engine of the whole thing is one move, repeated:



SCENE (what you remember from the movie) ? SYSTEM (what was actually happening underneath) ? STEAL THIS (how to use it in your marketing)



That connection is the assignment. I'm not looking for a specific design — I have no fixed idea of what this should look like and I don't want you reverse-engineering one. What I want to see is how you bridge a movie scene to an abstract sales principle to a marketing tactic, and how you make that bridge visible on a slide instead of explaining it in a caption. The analogy is the work. The layout is how you serve it.



I'll send the full content brief to anyone who applies — the ten techniques and the copy direction. How you visualize any of it is open.



What to submit — 3 slides only:



The cover — the slide that earns the swipe

Any two technique slides you choose from the ten in the brief



Which two you pick is part of what I'm reading. Choose the ones where you found the best analogy, not the ones that were easiest to lay out.



Deliver as PNGs at 1080 × 1350 (4:5). Include a sentence or two per slide on what you were going for — I want to see the thinking, not just the artifact.



Also include, in your application:



Links to 2–3 pieces of your best past work (carousel + video edit)

One short paragraph: what you'd change about our current Instagram

Your available hours per week and time zone



What I'm evaluating, in order:



The analogy — did you find a visual metaphor that carries the idea by itself? This is the biggest differentiator between candidates and it's most of my decision.

The book-to-movie bridge — does the slide connect the scene and the underlying principle, or does it just reference the movie and move on?

Visual storytelling — do the three slides feel like one system, or three unrelated graphics?

Typography — hierarchy, kerning, restraint.

Copy — is it tighter than what I gave you?



I'd rather see three slides that take a real creative swing and miss on one than three slides that are safe and competent. Competent is cheap. The concept is what I'm paying for.



Turnaround: Hiring will be made on August 16, 2026



How to apply



Send your application and assignment to 
 with the subject line "Social Media Designer — [Your Name]".



Applications without the assignment won't be reviewed.

 The Role



You'll be the first point of contact for leads coming in through our social media (primarily Instagram) who are interested in mentorship. Your mission: engage every lead, build trust, and book them onto paid strategy calls with V. You'll represent the brand directly in conversations, keep the pipeline clean, track payments, and act as V's right hand in running the day-to-day of the mentorship program.



This is a high-performance sales role for someone who loves the chase and gets a rush from closing.



 What You'll Do



- **Respond to inbound leads** across Instagram DMs and other channels — fast, consistently, and in V's voice, representing the Wealth By V brand

- **Proactive outreach & follow-up** — re-engage cold leads and keep conversations moving toward a booking; don't let leads go quiet

- **Track leads & pipeline** — maintain an accurate, up-to-date record of every lead, their status, and next steps

- **Track payments** — monitor incoming payments, flag outstanding balances, and keep clean records

- **Manage the mentee roster** — keep mentees organized, onboarded, and supported

- **Attend meetings** — join team calls, report on your numbers, and contribute to strategy

- **Assist V** — help keep the operation organized and running smoothly



## Who You Are



- A **highly motivated salesperson** — driven by targets and money

- **Persistent and proactive** — you follow up until you get a clear yes or no, and you're comfortable with high-volume outreach

- **A strong written communicator** — you can write like V: confident, warm, and persuasive

- **Organized and reliable** — nothing slips through the cracks

- **Trustworthy and discreet** — you'll handle sensitive lead and payment information with total confidentiality

- **Bonus:** experience in high-ticket sales, coaching/mentorship, or social media DM setting



## Compensation

- **Commission** on **[booked paid calls / closed sales — TBD]**

- Uncapped earning potential — the more you book and close, the more you make

1. **A short video introduction (2–3 min)** — who you are, your sales experience, and why you'd crush this role

2. **A cover page** — tell us specifically why you want to work with V and the Wealth By V brand

3. Your Resume: Sales experience is a MUST



We want people who genuinely believe in what we're building. Show us that.

The Client Success Manager (CSM) serves as a vital strategic pillar bridging client relationship management, end-to-end talent acquisition, and operational service delivery. Working in close alignment with the CEO, the CSM translates company vision into actionable operational and growth strategies. The CSM takes full accountability for managing the entire client lifecycle—from identifying high-value prospects, conducting initial discovery calls, and crafting tailored proposals, to overseeing offshore candidate screening, recruitment, and seamless onboarding.  



Beyond initial integration, the CSM acts as the primary client liaison, proactively managing client concerns, leading cross-functional teams (including Recruitment, HR, and Operations), and enforcing service quality through continuous performance monitoring, daily End-of-Shift reporting, and KPI tracking. By combining strategic workforce planning with hands-on process optimization, the CSM ensures exceptional service delivery, drives long-term client retention, and unlocks sustainable account growth across ProfitWorks' accounting and staffing solutions. 





Key Responsibilities



1. Client Engagement, Relationship & Account Growth

Manage the full client journey, acting as the primary point of contact for all client inquiries, feedback, and strategic account planning.

Foster long-term relationships and drive client retention through proactive communication, regular workforce alignment, and exceptional service delivery.

Support proposal development, agreement management, and account expansion opportunities with existing U.S. clients.



2. End-to-End Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

Partner directly with clients to define staffing needs, draft custom job profiles, and establish recruitment timelines.

Oversee recruitment and candidate screening workflows alongside internal sourcing teams to match top-tier offshore talent to client requirements.

Facilitate seamless onboarding, system integration, and task handoffs between clients and placed offshore contractors.



3. Performance Monitoring, Quality Assurance & Operations

4. Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Coordination

Collaborate closely across internal units—including Recruitment, HR, Operations, and Virtual Support teams—to ensure complete alignment with client expectations.

Lead internal syncs and alignment meetings to streamline communication, share feedback, and resolve challenges.

Provide coaching, support, and guidance to tea
mbers to maintain high service quality and continuous professional growth.

title: Supply Chain Manager (Fashion Dropshipping) – US Fashion E-Commerce Brand
description:
Supply Chain Manager (Fashion Dropshipping) – US Fashion E-Commerce Brand



We're hiring a Supply Chain Manager to own product listings, supplier relationships, and quality control for a growing US fashion e-commerce brand. This is a direct ownership role. You'll be the person making sure every product we list is accurately represented, correctly priced, and backed by a supplier who can actually deliver.



What you'll own



Sourcing and communicating directly with suppliers on pricing, availability, and order issues. Quality checks on new products before they go live, including materials, construction, and photos. Requesting, converting, and verifying size charts against US sizing standards. Creating and optimizing Shopify product listings, including variants, collections, and pricing. Confirming all colors, sizes, and variants are actually available before a product is listed. Monitoring supplier performance and flagging recurring issues like delays, quality drops, and stock problems. Coordinating with the customer support team when supplier issues affect customers directly.



What we're looking for



3+ years of hands-on experience in fashion dropshipping e-commerce, specifically. Direct experience communicating with suppliers, China-based suppliers a plus, on pricing, quality, and stock. Hands-on Shopify experience: product listings, variants, collections, inventory management. Experience creating or correcting size charts for the US market. Strong attention to detail, since you'll be catching mistakes before customers ever see them. Comfortable using tools like Google Sheets, Slack, and product import/listing apps. Available for graveyard shift, 6–7 days per week. Reliable home setup with stable internet and a power backup solution.



Nice to have



Experience with AI tools for product imagery or content, such as Higgsfield or Canva. Experience managing listings across multiple Shopify stores or markets. Background in identifying trending or high-performing products for a dropshipping catalog.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to own a real part of the business, not just execute tasks. If you know fashion dropshipping inside and out and want to build something long-term, we'd like to hear from you.

) Type: Full-time, remote Pay: $500 to $1,000/month USD + Bonuses. Probation of 1 to 3 months at $500/month base, then a raise based on performance. Hours: 40 hrs/week, with some flexibility on your schedule



About us



XMartial is a combat sports apparel brand (Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, MMA, Muay Thai). We have served over 100,000 customers in 50+ countries with distinctive designs and high-quality gear. We move fast, we ship often, and our designs are the reason people buy from us instead of everyone else.



What this role is



You design our apparel. Rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees: you create the vector artwork, build the print files, and produce the mockups that go live on the store and into our ads.



Design is the core of the job and where most of your week goes. The rest of your time you work as a general store assistant, supporting whatever the store needs that week: uploading and organizing products in Shopify, resizing and preparing images, editing banners, fixing catalog issues, and other hands-on tasks.



This is an independent role. We give you the brief, the references, and the print specs, and trust you to deliver finished, production-ready work without being chased.



What you will do



Apparel design (the main job)



Create original vector artwork for all-over-print combat sports apparel: rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees.

Build print-ready files that match manufacturer specs: correct dimensions, resolution, bleed, panel placement, and seam alignment across sizes.

Develop colorways and variations of existing designs, and keep whole collections visually consistent.

Work from a brief and from our existing style, while bringing your own ideas for designs you think will sell.



Mockups and visuals



Produce clean, realistic product mockups for the store, ads, and social.

Retouch and edit imagery in Photoshop so the catalog looks consistent and premium.

Create supporting graphics when needed: collection banners, promo images, product-page graphics.



General store assistant work



Upload and organize products in Shopify: images, variants, collections, tidying up messy or duplicate listings.

Prepare and resize assets for different placements across the store and ad channels.

Handle small ongoing tasks that keep the store accurate and up to date.

What we are looking for



Must have



Strong vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator. This is the core skill and we will test it.

Real experience designing apparel for print, ideally all-over sublimation. You understand how a flat file becomes a finished garment.

Photoshop skills for mockups and image retouching.

A portfolio of apparel or graphic design work. Required, no exceptions.

A strong eye for bold, modern design that fits combat sports culture.

Precision. Print files that are off by a few millimeters cost us real money, so details matter.

Willingness to do the non-design store tasks as well. This is not a pure design role.

Good written English and reliable communication.



Nice to have



You train BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, or wrestling, or you genuinely follow the sport.

Shopify experience.

Comfort using AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal) to work faster.

Figma, or experience building tech packs and working directly with manufacturers.

How we work



Before each project we agree on the brief, the references, and the specs, so nothing is fuzzy. We move fast and ship often. Strong applicants get a short paid trial task (one rashguard design plus a mockup) before we finalize.



How to apply



All applications go through our form. We do not accept applications by
 or DM.



Apply here: 

Have your portfolio ready, with at least a few apparel or print designs in it. To show you read this far, the form asks for a keyword: it is GRIP. Applications with the wrong or missing keyword are not reviewed.

title: Digital Product Sales Closer

3. Ask strong discovery questions to understand the prospect’s goals, challenges, and needs

4. Handle common sales objections confidently

5. Follow up with prospects who are not ready to purchase immediately

6. Close sales and guide clients through the enrollment/payment process

7. Follow scripts while still sounding natural and conversational

8. Build rapport without being afraid to ask for the sale

9. Help re-engage old leads, webinar attendees, and previous inquiries

You should have previous experience in sales, appointment setting, closing, enrollment, or lead conversion.



We strongly prefer someone who has:

*Experience selling courses, coaching, mentorship, consulting, or other digital products

*Experience working directly with an entrepreneur, coach, consultant, or online business owner

*Strong phone communication skills

*Confidence speaking to prospects about higher-priced offers

*Experience handling objections

*The ability to ask direct questions without sounding aggressive

Experience with GoHighLevel and Manychat is a major plus



You May Be a Great Fit If…

“What’s stopping you from getting started right now?”

“What would change for you if you were able to successfully build this business?”

“If this program gives you the roadmap you’ve been looking for, is there anything else preventing you from getting started?”



We do not want someone who simply reads a script. We want someone who can listen, think, communicate confidently, and guide the prospect toward making a decision.



What We Sell

Our offers include:

1. Business mentorship programs

2. Online business courses

3. Educational e-books and guides

4. Webinars and trainings



To Apply

Please send us:

*A short introduction about yourself and your sales experience

*Resume/Portfolio

*A short video introduction introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this position



Your answer to this question:



A prospect tells you, “I really want the mentorship, but I need to think about it.” How would you respond?



Important: Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable making calls, discussing money, handling objections, following up repeatedly, or directly asking prospects to enroll.

title: Experimentation Analyst (Part-Time - Split Testing & Data Quality)
description:
Do you have experience running and analyzing A/B or multivariate tests?



Are you fluent in Google Sheets or Excel — pivot tables, cohort tables, charts?



Do you understand statistical significance, sample size, and how to tell when a test is actually finished?



Do you actively push work forward instead of waiting to be told what to do next?



If yes to all four, you might be a great fit for this role.



We run ongoing split tests across our marketing funnels — testing different videos, headlines, page designs, and subscription routes to see what sells best. We need one careful, proactive person to own the system that keeps every test honest, organized, and moving.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



- Own the system of record for split tests. We already have a foundation — you'll take it over, build on it, and keep it sharp: one clear place that shows every test across every brand and where each one stands.

- Protect the data integrity of every split test. Set tests up so errors can't creep in, and on the rare occasion something slips through — a mismatched time window, a cherry-picked group, a wrong denominator — catch it before it reaches a decision.

- Make results easy to act on. Present each test so the winner, the margin, and the takeaway are clear at a glance — and make sure what we learn is captured where the team will actually use it, so no lesson gets lost.

- Reconcile the numbers. When two reports disagree on the same figure, find out which one is right and why, and write it down clearly so no one has to work it out again.

- Keep every new test set up right before it goes live — variables clearly identified, the success metric agreed up front, and the sample size worked out in advance.

- Stay on top of every running test and surface when it has enough data to call, so a winner is never picked too early.

- Push the pipeline forward. Keep test slots full, rank the backlog by leverage, and look ahead at what upcoming tests will need (tech setup, design assets, copy) so nothing stalls waiting on a dependency.



THE TOOLS



Day to day you'll work in spreadsheets and a handful of analytics and database tools — including Google Analytics (GA4), 
, HasOffers/TUNE, BigQuery, and a custom dashboard of our own. We'll get you up to speed on our specific setup; you bring the fundamentals.



We use AI tools in our own work, and you're welcome to use them here. What we care about is the judgment you bring on top of them. If you reach the paid test project, we'll ask which tools you used, AI included, and for the conversation logs.



YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU ARE



- Fluent in Google Sheets or Excel (pivot tables, cohort tables, charts).

- Comfortable with statistical hypothesis testing, significance, and sample-size estimation.

- Able to explain "why this test isn't done yet" to someone who isn't a statistician.

- Detail-oriented and organized — you don't let numbers slip through.

- Comfortable learning SQL, BI tools, or experimentation platforms.

- Someone who actively manages and pushes the work forward — keeps tests moving and flags what's next without waiting to be told.



TO APPLY



If you've read this far and think you'd be a great fit, reply with:



1. Why you're a strong match for this role.

2. Your favorite movie (so I know you read all the way to the end).



Qualified applicants will receive a short screening question, then a paid test project, then interviews with the hiring manager. One person will be chosen for the ongoing role after the trial.



This is a part-time contract: 10–20 hours per week, ongoing. Pay is $10–$15/hour, up to $18/hour for the right person.



This role requires you to track your hours with Time Doctor, which takes periodic screenshots of your screen while you work. If that is not comfortable for you, this is not the right fit.

title: Video Editor for Construction Training YouTube Channel (DaVinci Resolve, Long Form)
description:
I run Level Up Framing, a YouTube channel with ~16,000 subscribers that teaches house framing and construction. We have published ~70 long-form videos. Real carpenters watch our videos to learn a skill and earn a higher wage.



Right now I film everything and edit everything myself, 1 to 12+ hours per video, and it is the reason we only publish every other week. I want to publish weekly. I am looking for one editor to work with long term, starting with the technical prep and growing into the full edit.



What you would do:

The job comes in phases; you move up by hitting a clear standard. If you pick this up fast, Phase 2 could be week two. I will tell you in writing what each step up requires.



- Phase 1, preparation. I send you a synced timeline. You set audio channels, set gain, chop the audio to match the clips, link video to audio, separate B-roll onto its own track, and apply saved audio presets.

- Phase 2, rough cuts. Cutting the talking down, placing B-roll.

- Phase 3, the full edit. Graphics, music, the complete cut. You would also take over the audio syncing step at this point.

- Phase 4 and beyond, if you want it. Thumbnails and publishing. Further out, color grading, if you are ambitious about it. I do the grading now and I am not promising to hand it over, but I would like to eventually.



I want someone to be in phase 3/4; phase 1/2 are purely training to that point.

You work on 1080p proxy files, which any modern computer handles easily.



Pay Structure:

Phase 1 (prep, includes paid training time) - $400/m - 4 edited videos / month

Phase 2 (rough cuts) - $550/m - 4 edited videos / month

Phase 3 (full edit) - $750/m - 4 edited videos / month

Phase 4 (beyond the edit) - pay & expectations tbd



Up to 2 rounds of revisions are included. Extra videos beyond 4 in a month are paid separately.



Phase 1 pays $400 even though the work itself is light, because I am also paying for your time to learn the workflow properly rather than rushing it.



There is no minimum time in any phase. Hit the standard and the rate goes up, whether that takes two weeks or two months. Each step up has clear written requirements, so you will know exactly where you stand, and I will not make you ask for the raise. Paid twice monthly, on the 1st and the 15th, via PayPal or Wise, whichever you prefer.



Required from you:

- DaVinci Resolve. We use DaVinci. If you have not used it and are not willing to learn it, this is not the right role.

Experience with long-form video, 10 minutes or more. Not just Reels and Shorts.

- Good written & spoken English. We need to be able to effectively communicate ideas to each other as we grow in our abilities.

- Internet fast enough to download about 2 to 5 GB per project.

- A computer that plays 1080p H.264 smoothly.

- A backup plan for power and internet. A UPS, and mobile data you can switch to. We publish on a weekly schedule and I need it to survive storm season. I am not expecting you to control the weather, I am expecting you to have thought about it.

- Reliability. I need to be able to schedule a publish date and trust it. If something goes wrong, tell me early. I am easy about problems I hear about in advance.



Strongly preferred, and I will weight this heavily:

You have edited instructional content. Tutorials, how-to, repair guides, cooking instruction, software walkthroughs, online courses. Anything where the viewer needs to follow along and actually learn to do something. That instinct is more useful to me than a cinematic reel.



Nice to have:

- Any construction, carpentry, or trades background at all, including family or previous work. Say so if you have it. It is genuinely valuable here and rare in this field.

- Multicam and audio-sync workflow experience.



What this job is not:

- Not cinematic or artistic work. Our footage is a job site. The right edit is often the plain one that effectively communicates an idea.

- Not color grading, at least not for a good while. I do the grading and I am picky about it. If you want to work toward it, say so, because I would like to hand it over one day.

- Not scriptwriting or thumbnails, at least at the start. I am open to handing off thumbnail production in the future.

- Not full time. Expect 8 to 12 hours a week initially. Our average video takes me around 6 hours to fully edit, import to upload.

- Not fast paced or urgent. It is steady, careful work on a weekly schedule.





How To Apply



Include the word GIRDER in your subject line, then send:

- A link to 2 or 3 long-form videos you edited. Tell me what you specifically did on each.

- What editing software you use most, and how long you have used DaVinci. If you have not used it, tell me what you do use and how you would get up to speed.

- Your setup: computer specs, your internet speed (run a speed test, give me both numbers), which province you are in, and whether you have backup power and a mobile data backup.

- How many hours a week you are available, and your timezone.

- This one matters most: think about the last instructional or how-to video you edited. Tell me about one thing you cut out, and why cutting it made the video better. A few sentences is plenty.



Applications without the word GIRDER will not be read. Applications that answer question 5 with something generic will not go far.



Next steps for shortlisted applicants: a short screen recording task (about 10 minutes of your time, unpaid), then a paid test project of $40 on real footage from our channel. If that goes well, we start.



Thanks for reading this far. I am looking for one person to work with for a long time, not the cheapest bid, so take the time to write a real application.



Jordan - Level Up Framing

title: Sandblast Stencil Production Artist
description:
# Job Title: Sandblast Stencil Production Artist



Position Type: Full-Time

Compensation: XXXXXX



---



### The Mission



To deliver 100% cut-ready, error-free vector stencil and engraving files to shop-floor operators (sandblast and laser), eliminating machine downtime, cut errors, stencil failures, and customer proof discrepancies.



---



### What You’ll Own & Accomplish (Your Outcomes)



If you thrive on clear expectations, measurable quality, and autonomy, you will love this role. Success in this position means hitting six key targets:



1. Plotter Perfection (99%+ Accuracy): Prepare vector files with zero unclosed paths or overlapping lines so our plotters cut cleanly on the first pass.

2. Laser Engraver Reliability (99%+ Accuracy): Handoff vector/raster files with perfect hairlines and color-mapping, resulting in zero shop-floor downtime or re-runs.

3. Zero Sandblast Failures: Verify that 100% of prepped stencils respect physical blast constraints (proper bridge gaps, stable stencil islands, and line thickness).

4. Hawk-Eye Quality Control: Catch 100% of basic design flaws—including typos, spelling errors, element shifts, and misalignments—against approved customer proofs before releasing files to the shop floor.

5. Fast, Consistent Turnaround: Maintain a 12-to-24-hour turnaround on incoming file prep requests to keep production moving smoothly.

6. Material Efficiency: Optimize cut-file layouts and nesting to cut vinyl, rubber, and material waste by 10–15%.



---



### What You Bring (Competencies)



* Vector Software Mastery: High fluency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, FlexiSign, SignLab, or Gerber.

* Cut Path & Laser Preflight Skills: Deep experience in node simplification, closing open paths, raster-to-vector tracing, and color-mapping.

* Material & Process Intuition: Understanding of plotter blade offsets, weeding boundaries, laser drivers, and physical sandblast resist limitations.

* Uncompromising Detail: You double-check your work against source files and take pride in leaving zero errors behind.

* Core Values: High dependability (on time, every time), radical ownership (reporting mistakes immediately), and clear, candid teamwork.



---



### Why Work With Us?



* Freedom & Autonomy: We hire capable people and give them room to do their jobs. You’ll have clear expectations and outcomes, without someone constantly looking over your shoulder.



* The Right Fit Matters: We want this to be a strong fit for both sides. We’re looking for someone whose strengths naturally match the work—someone who enjoys precision, takes ownership, and gets satisfaction from producing excellent work.



* Clear Expectations: You’ll know what success looks like. Rather than vague expectations, we define the outcomes that matter and give you the freedom to determine the best way to achieve them.



* Work That Matters: The files you prepare directly affect the quality of the finished memorial. Your attention to detail makes production run better and helps ensure families receive a monument that is accurate and worthy of the person it represents.



---



### How to Apply



We receive a high volume of applications, so please follow these instructions carefully. Applications that are incomplete or do not follow the steps below will not be considered.



Please submit:



1. Your resume or work history.

2. Provide 1–3 examples of relevant vector-production work if you have examples you are permitted to share. These may be screenshots, PDFs, portfolio images, or original files. If you cannot share previous work due to confidentiality or ownership restrictions, briefly describe the production work you performed instead.

3. A short explanation of your experience with Adobe Illustrator or CorelDRAW.

4. A brief answer to this question: What are the three most important things you would check before sending a vector stencil file to a sandblast operator?

5. Your current computer specifications and internet connection speed.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

7. Your normal working hours and availability in PST.

8. Include the words "CUT READY" at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full job description.



Finalists will be asked to complete a short practical work-sample test based on the type of files you would handle in this role. The test is designed to evaluate accuracy, attention to detail, vector-file preparation, and your ability to follow production instructions.



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily Canva, social-media graphics, photo editing, or general graphic design without strong vector-production experience. We are specifically looking for someone comfortable preparing technically accurate files that will be sent directly to production equipment.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be supporting the two founders of a well-established Canadian staffing and consulting firm based in Toronto. They run a highly systemised, fast-moving business, and they're the kind of leaders people want to work for: patient teachers with high standards, who invest in training, tooling, and growth for their team. They automate anything that can be automated, document their processes, and give their people the systems and support to do great work. This is a company that has kept the same right-hand EA for years at a time because they know how to set the right person up to win.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to become the operational right hand to both founders. This is a blended role: you'll run two demanding executive calendars and inboxes and own a broad, varied administrative workload that keeps the business moving behind the scenes.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a narrow checklist and told exactly what to do all day. It's for a confident, self-managing operator who thrives on variety, builds their own systems, and stays calm when they're switching between very different tasks. The founders manage their own time down to the 15-minute block, use tools like ClickUp and Calendly, and will meet with you regularly, drip responsibilities to you as you master them, and give you SOPs to follow. The learning curve is real, and the people who succeed here lean into it rather than get overwhelmed by it.

This role starts as an executor and is built to grow. As you learn how each founder thinks, you'll take on more ownership and judgment over time.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (Toronto) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT (night shift)

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Quarterly Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support (Two Founders)

• Calendar orchestration — Manage two busy, highly structured executive calendars, protect focus time, and keep both founders' days running smoothly — coordinating across their schedules without dropping a beat.

• Inbox management — Triage and organise both inboxes, draft replies for review, and gradually take over sending on their behalf as you learn their voice and judgment.

• Meeting prep — Prepare briefing materials and agendas, and make sure both founders walk into every meeting ready.

• Proactive time management — Run their calendars proactively the way they run their own — booked, protected, colour-coded, and always a step ahead.



Administrative & Operations Support

• Documents & agreements — Prepare and execute client agreements, build and customise proposals, and produce clean, professional documents, reports, and presentations.

• Systems & filing — Own and organise a large Google Drive database so records are structured and easy to find.

• Process execution — Follow documented SOPs to the letter and build your own systems where none exist — you'll be trusted to create order, not wait for it.

• RFP & portal management — Manage the process around RFP solicitations and government portals (managing the workflow, not answering them), keeping deadlines and submissions on track.

• General admin — Own the wide range of recurring and one-off admin that comes across the founders' desks so they can stay focused on high-value work.

Sales & Business Development Support

• Lead follow-up & CRM — Support business development with lead follow-up, prospect tracking, and keeping the CRM clean and up to date.

• Scheduling — Book and coordinate business development and prospect meetings.



Qualifications

Required

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a founder, CEO, or senior executive — ideally supporting more than one executive at a time

• Proven ability to manage demanding executive calendars and inboxes with discretion, structure, and good judgment

• Strong written and verbal English — you'll draft
s, documents, and correspondence on behalf of the founders daily

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

• Experience with broad, varied admin — documents, proposals, filing, process management — not just calendar and inbox

• Highly organised and self-disciplined — you keep everything in one system, not scattered across sticky notes, notebooks, and half-used lists

• A confident, self-managing operator who can switch gears between very different tasks without getting overwhelmed

• Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems early, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

• Comfortable working efficiently and being measured on output — you get the right work done in a reasonable amount of time

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

• Able to reliably work night shift (Toronto business hours) long-term



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting two or more executives at once

• Experience with ClickUp or another project management tool (Asana, Monday, Trello)

• Familiarity with CRM tools (logging contacts, deals, and activity)

• Experience with proposals, RFPs, or agreement/contract administration

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to work within an AI-first, automation-first workflow

• Background in staffing, recruiting, professional services, or consulting



Who Thrives in This Role

The founders have kept an EA in this role for years at a time when they've found the right person. Here's who that is:

• You lean into a learning curve instead of being intimidated by it — when something's new, your attitude is “I'll figure it out.”

• You thrive on variety and can switch between very different tasks in a single day without losing your footing

• You build your own systems and processes — you create order rather than wait to be handed it

• You're calm and low-drama under a full plate — you don't overthink or talk yourself out of things before you try them

• You're disciplined and organised — you manage your own time as tightly as the people you support manage theirs

• You work efficiently and take ownership — when something's in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarise, you don't ramble

• You're a fast learner who picks up new tools, systems, and preferences quickly, and genuinely enjoy working smarter with AI and automation



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

title: Construction Drafter / Architectural Detailer – Custom Balau Wood Deck
description:
I am looking for an experienced construction drafter / architectural detailer to prepare a detailed construction drawing package for a custom exterior Balau hardwood deck.



The goal is to produce drawings detailed enough that a carpenter or building crew can review the documents and move forward with construction without having to guess how the major components are intended to be assembled.



This is not primarily a rendering or conceptual-design position.



I need someone who understands construction documentation and detailing and can translate design information, dimensions, photographs, sketches and markups into clear, buildable drawings.



SCOPE:



The project includes detailing:

Balau hardwood decking

Deck framing/supporting construction

Balau fascia and skirting

Skirting attachment, corners and terminations

Integrated planter boxes

Planter box framing and deck interfaces

Metal posts and attachment details

Wood-to-metal connections

Stairs, including framing, stringers, treads and connections

Deck edges and transitions

Other conditions necessary to clearly communicate construction

Required Drawing Package



The final construction documents should include, as applicable:

Dimensioned deck plans

Framing/layout plans

Elevations

Sections

Enlarged construction details

Stair plans and sections

Planter box plans and sections

Skirting elevations/details

Metal post attachment details

Edge, corner and termination details

Material callouts

Dimensions

Fastener/hardware callouts where appropriate

Construction notes

Other details necessary for the building crew

Critical Details



Particular attention needs to be given to details such as:

How Balau deck boards are installed

How Balau skirting attaches to the underlying structure

Skirting corners and terminations

Planter construction

Planter/deck/skirting interfaces

Metal post attachment

Metal-to-wood interfaces

Stair construction and connections

Deck perimeter conditions

Transitions between different materials



The drawings should communicate what goes where, its dimensions, what it attaches to, and how the components are intended to fit together.



If information is missing or a condition requires engineering/design input, I expect you to identify it and ask rather than make unsupported assumptions.



SOFTWARE: 

I am flexible regarding software.



You may use AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp + LayOut, Archicad, Vectorworks, or another professional CAD/BIM platform.



I care much more about the quality and constructability of the drawings than which software is used.



Final deliverables should include:



Complete PDF construction drawing set

Editable/source CAD/BIM/model files

Ideal Candidate



You should have experience producing drawings that were actually used for construction or fabrication.



Relevant experience includes:

Architectural construction documents

Construction detailing

Residential construction

Wood framing

Exterior carpentry/decks

Stairs

Millwork/joinery

Shop drawings

Metal-to-wood connections

Plans, elevations, sections and enlarged details

U.S. construction projects and imperial dimensions

This is NOT primarily a rendering position.



If your portfolio mainly consists of architectural renderings or conceptual 3D models, this is probably not the right project.



I am specifically looking for someone who can detail how something gets built.



Compensation



$7–$10 USD/hour depending on experience, portfolio quality and demonstrated construction knowledge.



I am willing to pay toward the upper end of the range for someone who can work independently and produce excellent, construction-ready details.



There may be additional drafting work available for the right person after successful completion of this project.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



BALAU DECK – CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENTS



Then provide the following:



1. Portfolio



Send examples of construction drawings that you personally produced.



I especially want to see:



Enlarged construction details

Sections

Shop drawings

Wood construction

Decks or exterior structures

Stairs

Millwork/joinery

Metal-to-wood connections



Please do not send only renderings.



2. Built Project Example



Show me one project where drawings you produced were actually used by a contractor, carpenter, fabricator or construction crew.



Briefly explain what portions of the drawings you personally produced.



3. Software



Tell me which CAD/BIM software you normally use.



4. Construction Experience



Briefly describe your experience preparing construction documents and technical details.



5. Rate



Tell me your requested hourly rate in USD.



6. Availability



Tell me:



Hours available per week

Your normal working hours in Philippine time

How quickly you could begin

Selection Process



I will review applications primarily based on construction drawing quality and construction knowledge, not software preference.



Shortlisted candidates may be offered a small paid drafting test based on one detail from the actual deck project.



The test will evaluate your ability to take photographs, dimensions and design information and turn them into a clear construction detail.



Please only apply if you are comfortable producing drawings intended to be used by an actual building crew.

title: Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote Contract Position
description:
# Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote Contract Position



## About Shepherd Financial



Shepherd Financial is a full-service financial services company serving real estate investors nationwide. We specialize in private lending for distressed, value-add, and investment properties, including bridge, fix-and-flip, construction, and DSCR loans. We also support clients through our insurance and property disposition services.



## Position Overview



We are looking for an experienced remote mortgage loan processor to help manage loan files from initial application through closing. The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, comfortable communicating with borrowers and lenders, and able to manage multiple transactions with minimal supervision.



Experience processing private-money, business-purpose, construction, or fix-and-flip loans is strongly preferred.



## Responsibilities



* Review new loan submissions for accuracy and completeness

* Collect borrower, entity, property, and financial documentation

* Maintain organized digital loan files and processing checklists

* Submit complete loan packages to lenders

* Track outstanding conditions, deadlines, and closing requirements

* Follow up with borrowers, lenders, title companies, insurance agents, appraisers, and other parties

* Order or coordinate appraisals, title reports, insurance, and other third-party items

* Review entity documents, bank statements, credit reports, construction budgets, and borrower experience

* Assist with construction draw documentation when needed

* Provide borrowers with clear status updates

* Update the CRM and loan pipeline regularly

* Identify missing or inconsistent information before it delays underwriting

* Help move approved loans efficiently through closing



## Required Qualifications



* Several years of mortgage or loan-processing experience

* Strong understanding of the loan process from application through closing

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed-upon U.S. business hours

* Experience working with CRMs, spreadsheets,
, and digital document platforms

* Ability to handle confidential borrower and financial information professionally



## Preferred Experience



* Private-money or hard-money lending

* Business-purpose real estate loans

* Fix-and-flip and bridge financing

* Ground-up or renovation construction loans

* DSCR investment-property loans

* Construction budgets and draw requests

* Title, appraisal, insurance, and closing coordination

* GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and DocuSign



## Compensation and Schedule



* **Starting rate:** $5 per hour

* **Position type:** Remote independent contractor

* **Initial schedule:** Part-time, with hours based on loan volume

* **Growth opportunity:** Potential for increased hours and responsibilities as the company and loan pipeline grow



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your total years of mortgage-processing experience

2. The types of loans you have processed

3. Any private-lending or construction-lending experience

4. The average number of loan files you have managed simultaneously

5. Your experience communicating with borrowers, lenders, title companies, and insurance agents

6. The loan-processing and CRM systems you have used

7. Your availability during U.S. business hours

8. Your desired hourly rate

9. A short explanation of how you keep multiple loan files organized

10. A brief video or voice introduction describing your relevant experience



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and may be given a brief sample loan-file exercise.

The role combines service delivery management, project coordination, stakeholder engagement, operational leadership, and consulting. No two days will be the same - you'll balance strategic planning with hands-on delivery, helping clients achieve successful outcomes while continually improving the services we provide.



We're looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple priorities. You'll be expected to identify and manage risks, solve complex problems, communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, and help drive continuous improvement across both projects and operational services.



As our team continues to grow, there will be opportunities to expand your responsibilities, contribute to business improvement initiatives, and further develop your consulting and leadership skills.



This is a 100% work-from-home role based in the Philippines. The position may be structured as full-time, part-time or fractional, depending on the successful candidate's availability and DVE's resourcing requirements.



We are also looking for someone who can offer flexibility in their working hours to support client needs, meetings and service delivery across different time zones. While working arrangements will be agreed with the successful candidate, some flexibility around standard working hours will be important for this role.



A reliable internet connection, excellent written and verbal English, and a bachelor's degree are essential.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across service delivery, project management, and operational processes.

• Outstanding organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated critical thinking, analytical ability, and strong problem-solving skills.

• Experience identifying, managing, and mitigating delivery risks and resolving complex service issues.

• A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a distributed team.

• Digital transformation or technology consulting.

• Managed services or IT service delivery.

• Project delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).

• Helpdesk and ticketing systems.

• Working with international or remote teams.





TECHNICAL & HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS



Applicants will require:

• Capable of running Microsoft 365, Microsoft Visio, and other DVE applications

title: Claude Code/Codex Dev
description:
# Claude Code / AI-Assisted Developer – Finish Existing CRM



We are looking for a capable and reliable developer who is experienced with **Claude Code and AI-assisted software development** to help finish an existing CRM system.



This is **not a project starting from scratch**.



The CRM is already substantially built and functional. I have been developing it myself using Claude Code, but I no longer have enough time to finish the remaining features, testing and polish.



Your job will be to take over the existing project, understand the current codebase, and use Claude Code to efficiently bring the CRM to a production-ready state.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Review and understand the existing CRM and codebase

- Work through a clear list of remaining features and issues

- Use Claude Code extensively to develop and troubleshoot

- Test features properly rather than simply accepting AI-generated code

- Fix bugs and edge cases

- Improve existing functionality where required

- Commit changes cleanly using Git

- Keep the existing architecture unless there is a genuine reason to change it

- Provide a short daily update showing what has been completed and any blockers



The goal is simple:



**Finish the CRM, make sure it works properly, and get it ready for everyday business use.**



## Who We're Looking For



You do NOT need to be a senior software engineer.



I am more interested in someone who is:



- Very comfortable using Claude Code

- Technically capable and able to understand an existing codebase

- Good at debugging

- Comfortable with Git/GitHub

- Able to test their own work

- Resourceful and able to solve problems independently

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable and communicative

- Comfortable taking ownership of a project and pushing it through to completion



Experience building internal tools, dashboards, CRMs or business applications is a big advantage.



## Important



We are specifically looking for someone who **actually uses Claude Code for development**, rather than someone who has only experimented with ChatGPT or other AI tools.



You should understand how to give Claude Code context, work through larger tasks, review its changes, debug problems, and prevent it from making unnecessary changes to an existing application.



## Initial Project



Your first project will be completing an existing CRM for a UK business.



You will receive:



- Access to the existing codebase

- An explanation of how the CRM currently works

- A list of remaining requirements

- Guidance on the intended finished product



From there, I want someone who can take ownership and make progress without needing constant supervision.



There may be ongoing development and automation work available for the right person after the CRM is completed.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. How long have you been using Claude Code?

2. What have you personally built using Claude Code?

3. Describe the most complicated project you have completed with Claude Code.

4. How do you check that code generated by Claude actually works correctly?

5. What do you do when Claude Code keeps trying to fix a problem but isn't succeeding?

6. What is your experience with Git/GitHub?

7. Have you worked on an existing codebase that somebody else started?

8. Please include links/screenshots/examples of applications you have built, if available.



**Important screening question:**



At the very top of your application, write:



**"CLAUDE CRM"**



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



### Type of Role



Initially project-based / part-time, with the possibility of ongoing work.



### Working Hours



Flexible. You will be working with a UK-based business, but you do not need to work full UK hours as long as communication and progress are consistent.



### What Matters Most



I am not looking for someone who can simply prompt an AI.



I am looking for someone who can **use AI to get software finished.**
