title: Media Buyer / Ads Manager
description:
Part-Time Meta Ads Manager / Media Buyer — Local Lead Gen (Long-Term Role)



Company: Salt and Light Photography Company (Canada) Type: Part-time, ongoing, long-term Rate: Up to $500 USD/month to start (~10–15 hrs/week), with increases tied to performance Hours: Flexible — you set your schedule, but you must be reachable during some overlap with Pacific Time (Vancouver, Canada) and responsive within 24 hours on weekdays.



About Us



Salt and Light Photography Company is a family-run photography studio in British Columbia, Canada. We've been in business for 10 years and have spent the last year scaling seriously — building a small team of associate photographers, systemizing operations, and turning on paid advertising.



We're currently spending $3,000–$5,000 CAD/month on Meta ads to generate local booking inquiries. The account works, but it's being run by the owner between shoots and client work. We want a specialist who owns it properly.



This is not a "set up some ads and disappear" gig. We are looking for one person to run this account as their own for years to come.



What You'll Own

Full day-to-day management of our Meta Ads account 
 + Instagram)

Campaign structure, audience testing, budget allocation, and scaling decisions

Writing and iterating ad copy; directing creative (we produce the photo/video assets — you tell us what you need and why)

Creative testing cadence: knowing when an ad is fatigued and what to swap in

Pixel / Conversions API health, event tracking, and making sure lead data is actually reporting correctly

Weekly reporting — a short, plain-English summary of what happened, what you changed, and what you're testing next

Flagging when spend should go up on a winner and when it should be cut

Who We're Looking For



Required:



5–10 years of hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager. Not agency-adjacent, not "I managed the team that ran ads" — you personally built, launched, and optimized the campaigns.

Real experience with local, service-based lead generation (home services, med spas, real estate, dental, photography, events, etc.). This is a booking-inquiry business with a defined geographic radius — not e-commerce. If your entire portfolio is dropshipping and DTC ROAS, this likely isn't a fit.

Comfortable managing accounts in the $3K–$10K/month spend range and treating that budget like it's your own money.

Solid written English. You'll be writing ad copy aimed at North American consumers, and communicating directly with the owner.

You can explain your reasoning. We'd rather hear "I'm cutting this ad set because frequency hit 3.2 and CPL doubled" than "I optimized the campaigns."



Nice to have (mention if you have it):



Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRMs, and offline/CRM conversion tracking back into Meta

Landing page or funnel experience (Leadpages, Lovable, GHL funnels)

Experience marketing to a female-majority audience (weddings, families, branding sessions)

Basic Canva or video editing to cut existing assets into new ad variations



Not a fit if:



You're juggling 15 clients and this would be account #16

You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next

You outsource the actual work to someone else

Compensation & Growth



Starting at up to $500 USD/month for roughly 10–15 hours per week, paid monthly via Wise or your preferred method.



To be straight with you: we know that rate buys us a part-time slice of a good buyer, not a full-time senior one. So the deal is simple — if you drive our cost per booked inquiry down and we scale spend, your rate goes up with it. We'd rather find one strong person, pay them more over time, and never have to look again.



Hiring Process

You apply (instructions below)

Short paid trial: 1–2 hours working directly with the owner — we'll walk you through the live account and you'll give us your honest read on what you'd change and why. This trial is paid regardless of whether we move forward.

If it's a fit: we onboard you and hand over the account. Long-term, ongoing relationship.

How To Apply



Please follow these instructions exactly — applications that skip steps will not be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word AURORA so we know you read the full post.



2. Answer these four questions briefly:



How many years have you personally spent inside Meta Ads Manager, and what's the largest monthly budget you've managed?

Describe one local lead-generation account you've run. What was the offer, the monthly spend, and the cost per lead when you took it over versus when you handed it off (or today)?

What's the first thing you look at when you're handed an underperforming ad account, and why that first?

How many client accounts are you currently managing?



3. Include one screenshot from Ads Manager of a local lead-gen campaign you've run — cost per result and spend visible. Blur the client name if you need to.



4. Optional but strongly encouraged — send a Loom video (2–4 minutes). Introduce yourself, tell us how you'd approach an account like ours, and let us hear how you communicate. Applicants who include a Loom go to the top of the pile. We're hiring for a long-term working relationship, and seeing how you think out loud tells us more than a résumé does.



We read every application that follows the instructions, and we'll respond to shortlisted candidates within one week.



Looking forward to meeting you.



— Amber, Salt and Light Photography Company

• Follow our existing editing style and reference galleries

• Maintain organized project folders and file names



VIDEO EDITING RESPONSIBILITIES

• Synchronize camera footage and professional audio

• Select strong emotional 
nts and build a cohesive story

• Perform color correction and basic color grading

• Clean and balance dialogue, vows, speeches and music

• Create clean titles and transitions without over-editing

• Follow our preferred wedding-film style and reference projects



Premiere Pro experience is preferred for video editing, although strong DaVinci Resolve editors may also apply.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You should be:



• Experienced with real wedding photography and/or wedding video editing

• Detail-oriented

• Consistent with skin tones and colors

• Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

• Organized with large amounts of wedding media

• Reliable with deadlines

• Comfortable working independently

• Able to follow an established editing style instead of imposing your own style on every project

• Interested in a long-term position as our wedding business grows

MAJESTIC EDITOR

title: Senior Editorial Writer & Content Strategist
description:
We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew.

Senior Editorial Writer & Content Strategist 

Full-Time | Remote | Marketing





ModSquad is a global provider of managed digital engagement services. Our 10,000+ Mods chat with customers, moderate web content, manage communities, and buzz in social media for many of the world's coolest brands, including the NFL, Zendesk, and Topps, to name a few. We bring companies closer to their customers than ever before. From global enterprises to international agencies to hip new start ups, our clients have reaped the benefits of putting ModSquad's expertise to work. With experienced Mods available in 50+ languages in 70+ countries, we're your squad for the digital world.





We are seeking a Senior Editorial Writer & Content Strategist with a journalistic perspective to join our Marketing team. ModSquad is executing a brand-led marketing strategy, and in this role you will find the stories, structure the competitive positioning, and shape authoritative content published on behalf of our executive leadership.





This is not a content marketing role. We are not looking for someone to feed a CMS or optimize for keywords. We are looking for a writer and editor who can interview executives, surface the stories buried inside our client work, and shape them into pieces that people in CX, Trust & Safety, and digital operations actually want to read.





You will sit within the Content & Creative Production function and report to the Head of Brand. You will partner closely with the VP of Marketing, Account Management, Sales, and internal subject matter experts across the business, and you will provide editorial direction to a junior writer. If you have worked at a trade publication, written editorial for a B2B brand with a real point of view, or ghostwritten executive bylines that didn't sound like press releases, we should talk.





Responsibilities / Duties:



Ghostwrite executive articles for distribution across owned, social, and external channels

Develop sponsored editorial and co-authored pieces for targeted trade publishers

Source and shape client and partner stories, both anonymized and attributed, that read as authentic rather than templated

Conduct interviews with internal SMEs, clients, and partners to extract story angles and unique perspectives

Support live programming, including office hours, podcast appearances, and recurring conversations with senior ModSquad voices

Shape and maintain an editorial cadence across pillars: customer support, trust & safety, content moderation, AI/automation, business systems, and security

Monitor the competitive and trade publishing landscape and identify the gaps our voice can fill

Provide editorial direction to a junior writer; review drafts for structure, clarity, and consistent point of view

Partner with the VP of Marketing to align editorial output with partner co-marketing needs

Partner with Account Management and Sales to identify client stories worth telling

Build a repeatable process for sourcing, developing, and clearing client stories



Who you are:



6–8 years of professional writing experience, with a meaningful portion in journalism, editorial, or trade publishing

Demonstrable experience in executive ghostwriting, with samples you can speak to

Background covering or writing for audiences in one or more of: customer experience, enterprise SaaS, trust & safety, BPO/outsourcing, or digital operations

Familiar with how trade publications work, including sponsored content, co-authorship, and pitching editorial angles

Comfortable in plain text workflows, Markdown, and GitHub



Knowledge and Skills:



Story Sense: You can pull a story out of a 30-minute conversation with a busy executive, and you know which 30 minutes are worth booking

Argument Construction: You can take a pile of ideas or a rough brief and build a coherent, logical argument that holds up

Craft: You know how to diagram a sentence, apply the Paramedic Method from Revising Prose, or have read Several Short Sentences About Writing more than once and have thoughts about how to apply it editorially

Editorial Judgment: You operate with judgment, not just execution, and you push back when a brief doesn't have a story in it yet

Self-Direction: You are fast and self-directed and can set your own production pace without heavy oversight

Standards: You're allergic to AI slop, and you're already thinking about how to improve this job description



PRO TIP: You're a writer. Write. Applications should include a portfolio of writing samples, and we strongly encourage a cover letter. Your responses should be comprehensive and grammatically correct. This will greatly increase the probability of scoring an interview.

 



ModSquad is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, military status, status as a veteran or disabled veteran, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, genetic information, medical condition, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.

title: Sales and Customer Support Executive - US E-commerce
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing US based online store selling premium, high-ticket bathroom fixtures.  Most of our products cost hundreds to several thousand dollars each. 



This is not a high-volume, call center script job. We are a high-ticket business, and we win on the quality of our care, not on speed or numbers. You will not be rushing through dozens of tickets an hour. Instead you will give each customer real attention, become their trusted advisor on a big purchase, and see the direct impact of your work every single day. You will also learn ecommerce up close, the way it actually runs behind the scenes, from how orders move through Shopify to how we work with suppliers, price products and win the sale.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer presales questions by
, live chat and phone (patient, warm, professional English)

- Help customers choose the right product and confirm it will fit their bathroom (we will train you on the fitment process)

- Answer technical product questions using manufacturer spec sheets and installation manuals (never guessing)

- Process and manage orders in Shopify: check availability, place orders with our suppliers, send tracking, and keep the customer updated

- Coordinate with our distributors and shipping carriers, and handle any delays, returns or freight or damage claims

- Follow up on abandoned checkouts and quotes every day (these are our warmest leads)

- Call recently delivered customers to check in and ask for a review

- Manage conversations and follow ups inside our CRM, GoHighLevel

- Keep our order tracker and notes accurate and up to date





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written AND spoken English. This is essential. You will be speaking and writing to US customers every day, and your English needs to sound natural, warm and clear.

- Someone who takes pride in doing customer care properly, not quickly. On a high-ticket purchase, one customer looked after brilliantly is worth far more than ten rushed. If you are happiest giving people real attention and getting it right, you will thrive here.

- At least 2 years of experience in customer service or sales (ecommerce experience strongly preferred)

- Comfortable on the phone with US customers, not just
 and chat

- Organized and reliable. You follow up without being reminded and you never let a customer wait.

- Able to read a spec sheet or manual and explain it simply to a non technical customer

- Honest and calm under pressure, especially with a frustrated customer

- A fast, reliable internet connection and a quiet place to take calls

- Available to work US business hours (Eastern Time)





NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with Shopify

- Experience with GoHighLevel (or any CRM)

- Experience selling or supporting higher priced products

- Any background in home improvement, plumbing, or bathroom or kitchen fixtures





TOOLS YOU WILL USE



- Shopify (orders, customers, fulfillment)

- GoHighLevel (our CRM for calls, messaging and follow ups)

- Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Meet, Google Docs and Sheets

- Supplier portals (we will train you)





WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US



- Paid on time, every time, in USD, plus sales commission, so the better you take care of customers, the more you earn.

- Work directly with the owner, not through layers of management. Your ideas get heard and used.

- Full training on our products, tools and process. You will never be thrown in the deep end.

- Learn premium ecommerce from the inside: Shopify, a real US brand, and high ticket sales.

- A stable, long term role. We are growing, and we want you to grow with us.





HOURS AND PAY



- Full time, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm US Eastern Time

- Salary: 500 USD per month plus sales commission. We pay on time, every time, and reward good work with raises.

- Long term role with room to grow as the business grows





HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY)



We read every application, and we can tell who actually read this post. Please follow these steps exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be considered.



1. Start your message with the word FLUSH so we know you read the full post.



2. Answer these questions in your message:

   - How many years of experience do you have in customer service or sales? Please tell us what type 
, chat, phone, ecommerce, etc.).

   - Have you used Shopify and GoHighLevel before? If yes, briefly describe how.



3. Answer this short sample question so we can see how you would talk to a customer:

   "A customer
s and asks: Will this bidet toilet seat fit my toilet? How would you reply to them?"

   Write your reply exactly as you would send it to the customer.



4. Record a short voice message (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in English, so we can hear how you speak. You can use 
 (free, no signup) and paste the link, or send a Loom. Tell us your name, your experience, and why you would be great in this role.



5. Attach your CV or resume. This is required.



6. Include your
 address. If we move forward, we will invite you to a short interview on Google Meet, so please give the
 you use for Google Meet.



Thank you for taking the time to apply properly. We are excited to meet you.

title: Maintenance Coordinator - Trainee
description:
Position Overview

Ready to grow in a hands-on, fast-paced role that keeps homes running smoothly and residents happy? Join GPS Renting as a Maintenance Coordinator Trainee. You’ll start full-time and spend your first months learning the core of maintenance coordination—triaging requests, dispatching vendors, communicating with residents and owners, and ensuring repairs are completed on time and on budget.



This immersive trainee role builds skills in prioritization, problem-solving, critical thinking, and customer delight. As you progress, you’ll take on a defined maintenance coordination portfolio—owning work orders end-to-end, supporting preventative maintenance plans, and helping improve our systems and vendor performance.



This program is a launchpad into a fulfilling career in property management operations at GPS Renting.



About GPS Renting

At GPS Renting, we’re not just managing properties; we’re building a culture of growth, integrity, and excellence.

Our Mission: Help our team develop professionally and personally while giving back to the community by delivering a 5-star customer service experience to owners and residents.



Our Niche: Providing simple, data-driven, low-cost yet high-value property management services for single-family homes with an average rent of $3,000/month.



We are a family-owned business in Seattle with a 8-year history of cultivating long-term relationships with our employees and clients. Professional, Honest, and Kind are our foundation. We live intentionally, and we want teammates who are inspired by our mission and eager to grow with us.



What You’ll Do

As a Maintenance Coordinator Trainee, you will:

Intake & Triage

Receive, categorize, and prioritize maintenance requests from residents and owners.

Troubleshoot basic issues and provide first-line guidance when appropriate.

Vendor Coordination - Source, schedule, and dispatch licensed/insured vendors.

Confirm scopes, pricing ranges, and SLAs; follow up to ensure quality and timeliness.

Maintain accurate vendor notes, availability, and performance data.





Work Order Management

Open, update, and close work orders in our systems with complete documentation.

Communicate status updates proactively to residents and owners.

Track estimates, approvals, photos, and invoices.



Quality, Safety & Compliance

Ensure work adheres to standards and warranty guidelines.

Support preventative maintenance calendars and seasonal readiness checklists.

Escalate urgent issues and follow emergency protocols.



Data & Process Improvement

Monitor metrics (first-response time, time-to-schedule, time-to-complete, resident satisfaction).

Identify bottlenecks and propose improvements to workflows and templates.



Key Skills We Focus On

Prioritization: Manage competing tasks to meet SLAs and keep stakeholders informed.

Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Diagnose issues, ask great questions, and navigate constraints.

Customer Delight: Communicate clearly and kindly; build trust with residents, owners, and vendors.

Operational Rigor: Detail-oriented documentation and reliable follow-through.



What We’re Looking For

Growth mindset and comfort stepping outside your comfort zone

Service-oriented communicator who can stay calm under pressure.

Tech-savvy, organized, and eager to learn maintenance best practices.

Alignment with our vivid vision of intentional living and growth.



Position Details

Employment Type: Full-time.

Compensation: $640/month, which is $4/hour. With the growth potential to $1120/month, which is $7 per hour

Schedule: Monday–Friday starting at 8:00 AM PST; occasional on-call or after-hours support may be required during training and/or on a rotation.



Requirements

High English proficiency (written and spoken).

Strong computer skills and stable internet connection.

Self-starter with excellent attention to detail.



Why Join GPS Renting?

A Career, Not Just a Job: Many teammates have grown with us for 5+ years.

Family Culture: Mutual respect, professional growth, and work-life balance.

Intentional Living: A team aligned around personal and professional development.

Impact: Create meaningful experiences for owners and residents every day.



How to Apply

1. Send your application materials to 
 with the subject line: “Maintenance Coordinator Trainee Application – [Your Name]”

2. Once these materials are submitted, you’ll receive an assessment to complete.



We’re excited to meet you and explore how you can grow with GPS Renting.
